films.description: Two female friends with very different ideals decide to start a beauty company together. One is more practical, while the other wants to earn her fortune and live a lavish lifestyle.

films.title: Skyline
films.cast: Eric Balfour, Scottie Thompson, David Zayas, Donald Faison
films.description: When strange lights descend on the city of Los Angeles, people are drawn outside like moths to a flame where an extraterrestrial force threatens to swallow the entire human population off the face of the Earth. Now the band of survivors must fight for their lives as the world unravels around them.

films.title: Upside Down
films.cast: Kirsten Dunst, Jim Sturgess, Timothy Spall, James Kidnie
films.description: In an alternate universe where twinned worlds have opposite gravities, a young man battles interplanetary prejudice and the laws of physics in his quest to reunite with the long-lost girl of his dreams in this visually stunning romantic adventure that poses the question: what if love was stronger than gravity?

films.title: The Great Debaters
films.cast: Denzel Whitaker, Denzel Washington, Nate Parker, Jurnee Smollett
films.description: The true story of a brilliant but politically radical debate team coach who uses the power of words to transform a group of underdog African-American college students into a historical powerhouse that took on the Harvard elite.

films.title: Heartbreak Ridge
films.cast: Clint Eastwood, Marsha Mason, Everett McGill, Moses Gunn
films.description: A hard-nosed, hard-living Marine gunnery sergeant clashes with his superiors and his ex-wife as he takes command of a spoiled recon platoon with a bad attitude.

films.title: Journey to Bethlehem
films.cast: Fiona Palomo, Milo Manheim, Antonio Banderas, Joel Smallbone
films.description: A young woman carrying an unimaginable responsibility. A young man torn between love and honor. A jealous king who will stop at nothing to keep his crown.

films.title: Plan 75
films.cast: Chieko Baisho, Hayato Isomura, Stefanie Arianne, Yuumi Kawai
films.description: In a Japan of the near future, the government program Plan 75 encourages senior citizens to be voluntarily euthanized to remedy a super-aged society. An elderly woman whose means of survival are vanishing, a pragmatic Plan 75 salesman, and a young Filipino laborer face choices of life and death.

films.title: 200 Cigarettes
films.cast: Ben Affleck, Casey Affleck, Dave Chappelle, Guillermo Díaz
films.description: In 1981 New York City, a collection of twentysomethings try to cope with relationships, loneliness, desire and their individual neuroses on New Years Eve.

films.title: Police Story 4: First Strike
films.cast: Jackie Chan, Jackson Liu, Annie Wu, Bill Tung
films.description: Hong Kong cop Chan Ka-Kui returns, working with Interpol to track down and arrest an illegal weapons dealer. Chan later realizes that things are not as simple as they appear and soon finds himself to be a pawn of an organization posing as Russian intelligence.

films.title: The Canyons
films.cast: Lindsay Lohan, James Deen, Gus Van Sant, Nolan Gerard Funk
films.description: The discovery of an illicit love affair leads two young Angelenos on a violent, sexually charged tour through the dark side of human nature.

films.title: Playing with Fire
films.cast: John Cena, Keegan-Michael Key, John Leguizamo, Tyler Mane
films.description: A crew of rugged firefighters meet their match when attempting to rescue three rambunctious kids.

films.title: Songbird
films.cast: K.J. Apa, Sofia Carson, Craig Robinson, Bradley Whitford
films.description: During a pandemic lockdown, Nico, a young man with rare immunity, must overcome martial law, murderous vigilantes and a powerful family to reunite with his love, Sara.

films.title: Duplicity
films.cast: Julia Roberts, Clive Owen, Tom Wilkinson, Paul Giamatti
films.description: Two romantically-engaged corporate spies team up to manipulate a corporate race to corner the market on a medical innovation that will reap huge profits and enable them to lead an extravagant lifestyle together.

films.title: Police Academy 4: Citizens on Patrol
films.cast: Steve Guttenberg, Bubba Smith, Michael Winslow, David Graf
films.description: A new batch of recruits arrives at Police Academy, this time a group of civilian volunteers who have joined Commandant Lassard's new Citizens on Patrol program. Although the community relations project has strong governmental support, a disgusted Captain Harris is determined to see it fail.

films.title: 3 Faces
films.cast: Behnaz Jafari, Jafar Panahi, Marziyeh Rezaei, Maedeh Erteghaei
films.description: Filmmaker Jafar Panahi and actor Behnaz Jafari travel to a tiny village after receiving a plea for help from a girl whose family has forbidden her from studying acting. Amusing encounters abound, but they soon discover that the local hospitality is rivaled by the desire to protect old traditions.

films.title: Fourteen
films.cast: Tallie Medel, Norma Kuhling, Evan Davis, Willy McGee
films.description: Twentysomething Brooklynites Mara and Jo have been close friends since middle school. Gradually, it becomes apparent that the increasingly unstable Jo has troubles that may be the result of substance abuse, or an even deeper problem. Over the course of a decade, the more stable Mara tries to help.

films.title: The Hole
films.cast: Chris Massoglia, Nathan Gamble, Haley Bennett, Teri Polo
films.description: After moving into a new neighbourhood, brothers Dane & Lucas and their neighbour Julie discover a bottomless hole in the basement of their home. They find that once the hole is exposed, evil is unleashed. With strange shadows lurking around every corner and nightmares coming to life, they are forced to come face to face with their darkest fears to put an end to the mystery of THE HOLE.

films.title: Nowhere Special
films.cast: James Norton, Daniel Lamont, Eileen O'Higgins, Valerie O'Connor
films.description: John, a 35-year-old window cleaner, has dedicated his life to bringing up his 4-year-old son, Michael, after the child's mother left them soon after giving birth. When John is given only a few months left to live, he attempts to find a new, perfect family for Michael, determined to shield him from the terrible reality of the situation.

films.title: Encounters of the Spooky Kind
films.cast: Sammo Hung, Paul Chung Fat, Wu Ma, Lam Ching-Ying
films.description: "Big Guts" Cheung, a man well known in his local village for his lack of fear, is put to the test after being trick into spending the night in a temple full of spirits, zombies, and vampires.

films.title: Unrest
films.cast: Clara Gostynski, Alexei Evstratov, Monika Stalder, Hélio Thiémard
films.description: In 1877, in a watch factory in a valley in north-western Switzerland, Josephine produces balance spindles, tiny parts that ensure the agitation movement ("unrueh") of the mechanical watches. She soon grows uneasy with the organisation of work and possession in the village and its factory and joins the anarchist worker movement of the local watchmakers. There she meets Piotr Kropotkin, a moony…

films.title: Dance with the Devil
films.cast: Rosie Perez, Javier Bardem, Harley Cross, Aimee Graham
films.description: She's sexy, shameless and loves taking people to their limit. She's a dangerous young woman who dreams about a jaguar that licks her naked body and sleeps by her side. Her past is bathed in blood and weird passions. Now she's met the man of her wildest dreams. He's dark, tough and mysterious. He likes robbing banks, trafficking in corpses and spicing it all with voodoo rituals. Together, the duo…

films.title: Fifty Shades of Black
films.cast: Marlon Wayans, Kali Hawk, Fred Willard, Mike Epps
films.description: An inexperienced college student meets a wealthy businessman whose sexual practices put a strain on their relationship.

films.title: Before, Now & Then
films.cast: Happy Salma, Laura Basuki, Ibnu Jamil, Rieke Dyah Pitaloka
films.description: Set against Indonesia’s turbulent post-independence years in the 1960s, the story revolves around the domestic life of a woman whose personal life has been completely overturned by the political turmoil.

films.title: Hell in the Pacific
films.cast: Lee Marvin, Toshirō Mifune
films.description: During World War II, a shot-down American pilot and a marooned Japanese navy captain find themselves stranded on the same small uninhabited island in the Pacific Ocean.

films.title: Norm of the North
films.cast: Rob Schneider, Heather Graham, Maya Feltheimer, Ken Jeong
films.description: Polar bear Norm and his three Arctic lemming buddies are forced out into the world once their icy home begins melting and breaking apart. Landing in New York, Norm begins life anew as a performing corporate mascot, only to discover that his new employers are directly responsible for the destruction of his polar home.

films.title: Sanctum
films.cast: Richard Roxburgh, Ioan Gruffudd, Rhys Wakefield, Alice Parkinson
films.description: Master diver Frank McGuire has explored the South Pacific's Esa-ala Caves for months.  But when his exit is cut off in a flash flood, Frank's team—including 17-year-old son Josh and financier Carl Hurley are forced to radically alter plans.  With dwindling supplies, the crew must navigate an underwater labyrinth to make it out.

films.title: Asterix & Obelix: God Save Britannia
films.cast: Édouard Baer, Gérard Depardieu, Guillaume Gallienne, Vincent Lacoste
films.description: Asterix crosses the channel to help second-cousin Anticlimax face down Julius Caesar and invading Romans.

films.title: The Legend of Hercules
films.cast: Kellan Lutz, Liam McIntyre, Gaia Weiss, Scott Adkins
films.description: In Ancient Greece 1200 B.C., a queen succumbs to the lust of Zeus to bear a son promised to overthrow the tyrannical rule of the king and restore peace to a land in hardship. But this prince, Hercules, knows nothing of his real identity or his destiny. He desires only one thing: the love of Hebe, Princess of Crete, who has been promised to his own brother. When Hercules learns of his greater…

films.title: A Vigilante
films.cast: Olivia Wilde, Morgan Spector, Tonye Patano, Judy Marte
films.description: A once-abused woman devotes herself to ridding victims of their domestic abusers while hunting down the one she must kill to be truly free.

films.title: Red Shoes and the Seven Dwarfs
films.cast: Chloë Grace Moretz, Sam Claflin, Gina Gershon, Patrick Warburton
films.description: Princes who have been turned into Dwarfs seek the red shoes of a lady in order to break the spell, although it will not be easy.

films.title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War -The First Kiss That Never Ends-
films.cast: Makoto Furukawa, Aoi Koga, Konomi Kohara, Ryota Suzuki
films.description: After pining for one another and plotting for so long, Kaguya Shinomiya and Miyuki Shirogane finally have their climactic first kiss. However, they struggle to define their relationship. After all, how much of their true selves have they really shown to one another?

films.title: A Hijacking
films.cast: Pilou Asbæk, Søren Malling, Dar Salim, Roland Møller
films.description: Tensions are high after a Danish freighter is captured and held for ransom by Somali pirates, leading to weeks of high-stakes negotiations – and an escalating potential for explosive violence.

films.title: King of Thieves
films.cast: Michael Caine, Jim Broadbent, Tom Courtenay, Charlie Cox
films.description: London, England, April 2015. Brian Reader, a retired thief, gathers an unlikely gang of burglars to perpetrate the biggest and boldest heist in British history. The thieves assault the Hatton Garden Safe Deposit Company and escape with millions in goods and money. But soon the cracks between the gang members begin to appear when they discuss how to share the loot.

films.title: Poker Face
films.cast: Russell Crowe, Liam Hemsworth, RZA, Brooke Satchwell
films.description: A yearly high-stakes poker game between childhood friends turns into chaos when the tech billionaire host unveils an elaborate scheme to seek revenge for the ways they've betrayed him over the years. But as his plans unfold, a group of thieves hatch plans of their own breaking into the mansion thinking it is empty. The old friends quickly band together and the years of playing the game help them…

films.title: Love Affair(s)
films.cast: Camélia Jordana, Niels Schneider, Vincent Macaigne, Émilie Dequenne
films.description: Vacations in the French countryside. Daphne, three months pregnant, finds herself alone to welcome Maxime, her boyfriend François’ cousin. François had to leave in a hurry for Paris to cover for a sick colleague. For four days, while waiting for his return, Daphne and Maxime get to know each other and share very intimate stories that bring them closer...

films.title: The Divide
films.cast: Lauren German, Michael Biehn, Milo Ventimiglia, Courtney B. Vance
films.description: Survivors of a nuclear attack are grouped together for days in the basement of their apartment building, where fear and dwindling supplies wear away at their dynamic.

films.title: Shrooms
films.cast: Lindsey Haun, Jack Huston, Max Kasch, Maya Hazen
films.description: A group of American teens comes to Ireland to visit a friend who takes them on a camping trip in search of the local, fabled magic mushrooms. When the psychedelics start taking hold, the panicked friends are attacked by ghostly creatures; but how can they determine whether what they are experiencing is reality or hallucination?

films.title: I Can Only Imagine
films.cast: J. Michael Finley, Dennis Quaid, Cloris Leachman, Brody Rose
films.description: 10-year-old Bart Millard lives with his mother and abusive father Arthur in Texas. One day his mother drops him off at a Christian camp where he meets Shannon. Upon his return from camp, Bart finds his mother has left and movers are removing her belongings. He angrily confronts his father, who denies that his abusiveness was the reason she left. Years later, in high school, Bart and Shannon are…

films.title: Our Kind of Traitor
films.cast: Ewan McGregor, Stellan Skarsgård, Damian Lewis, Naomie Harris
films.description: A young Oxford academic and his attorney girlfriend holiday in Morocco. They bump into a Russian millionaire who owns a peninsula and a diamond watch. He wants a game of tennis. What else he wants propels the lovers on a tortuous journey to the City of London and its unholy alliance with Britain's intelligence establishment, to Paris and the Alps.

films.title: Major Grom: Plague Doctor
films.cast: Tikhon Zhiznevsky, Lyubov Aksyonova, Aleksey Maklakov, Alexandr Seteykin
films.description: In present day St. Petersburg, police major Igor Grom, an honest and skilled cop with unconventional methods, pursues a vigilante murderer in the mask of a plague doctor.

films.title: Best Sellers
films.cast: Michael Caine, Aubrey Plaza, Scott Speedman, Ellen Wong
films.description: A cranky, retired author reluctantly embarks on a final book tour to help out a young publisher.

films.title: The Deer King
films.cast: Shinichi Tsutsumi, Ryoma Takeuchi, Anne Watanabe, Hisui Kimura
films.description: Following a brutal war, former soldier Van toils in a mine controlled by the ruling empire. One day, his solitary existence is upended when a pack of wild dogs carrying a deadly and incurable disease attack, leaving only Van and a young girl named Yuna as survivors. Finally free, the pair seek out a simple existence in the countryside but are pursued by nefarious forces. Intent on protecting Yuna…

films.title: The Portable Door
films.cast: Christoph Waltz, Patrick Gibson, Damon Herriman, Sophie Wilde
films.description: Paul and Sophie, interns at a mysterious London firm, become steadily aware their employers Humphrey and Dennis are anything but conventional – they are disrupting the world of magic by bringing modern corporate strategy to ancient magical practices.

films.title: Ryuichi Sakamoto: Opus
films.cast: Ryuichi Sakamoto
films.description: “Ars longa, vita brevis” – art is long, life is short. This is one of Japanese music icon Ryuichi Sakamoto’s favorite quotes, and the message that he leaves for viewers at the end of his final concert film, shot before he succumbed to cancer in March 2023. Consisting of only Sakamoto and his piano, Opus features the final live performances of 20 songs that Sakamoto meticulously curated to…

films.title: Le Brio
films.cast: Daniel Auteuil, Camélia Jordana, Yasin Houicha, Nozha Khouadra
films.description: After an incident, a brilliant professor known for his outbursts is forced to mentor the student he wronged for a speech contest.

films.title: Chatroom
films.cast: Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Imogen Poots, Matthew Beard, Hannah Murray
films.description: When strangers Jim, Eva, Emily and Mo meet William online in his new 'Chelsea Teens!' chatroom, they're completely seduced by his fast-talking, charismatic character. But beneath the surface lies a much darker truth. William is a dangerous loner, channeling all his energies into cyberspace. He's become an analyser, a calculating manipulator who finds it almost impossible to interact normally with…

films.title: Seeking Justice
films.cast: Nicolas Cage, January Jones, Guy Pearce, Harold Perrineau
films.description: After his wife is assaulted, a husband enlists the services of a vigilante group to help him settle the score.

films.title: Iron Sky: The Coming Race
films.cast: Lara Rossi, Vladimir Burlakov, Kit Dale, Julia Dietze
films.description: 29 years after the events of Iron Sky, the former Nazi Moonbase has become the last refuge of mankind. Earth was devastated by a nuclear war, but buried deep under the wasteland lies a power that could save the last of humanity - or destroy it once and for all. An old enemy leads our heroes on an adventure into the Hollow Earth. To save humanity, they must battle the Vril, an ancient…

films.title: Little Richard: I Am Everything
films.cast: Little Richard, John Waters, Mick Jagger, Billy Porter
films.description: The story of the Black queer origins of rock n' roll. It explodes the whitewashed canon of American pop music to reveal the innovator – the originator – Richard Penniman. Through a wealth of archive and performance that brings us into Richard's complicated inner world, the film unspools the icon's life story with all its switchbacks and contradictions.

films.title: The Long Farewell
films.cast: Zinaida Sharko, Oleg Vladimirsky, Yuri Kayurov, Lidiya Dranovskaya
films.description: A single mother is confused by the changes in her teenage son, who has become distant since spending summer vacation with his father.

films.title: The Debt Collector
films.cast: Scott Adkins, Louis Mandylor, Michael Paré, Tony Todd
films.description: A classically-trained martial artist goes to work as a debt collector for the mob. The job seems easy enough, until one “client” pulls him into a situation deeper than could ever be expected.

films.title: Genesis
films.cast: Théodore Pellerin, Noée Abita, Édouard Tremblay-Grenier, Pier-Luc Funk
films.description: Three teenagers are shaken up by their first loves in the turmoil of their youth. At a time when others are conforming, they stand their ground and assert their right to love and be free.

films.title: Katyn
films.cast: Andrzej Chyra, Maja Ostaszewska, Artur Żmijewski, Danuta Stenka
films.description: On September 1st, 1939, Nazi Germany invades Poland, unleashing World War II. On September 17th, the Soviet Red Army crosses the border. The Polish army, unable to fight on two fronts, is defeated. Thousands of Polish men, both military and government officials, are captured by the invaders. Their fate will only be known several years later.

films.title: Overdrive
films.cast: Scott Eastwood, Freddie Thorp, Ana de Armas, Gaia Weiss
films.description: Master car thieves square off against French gangsters in the South of France with money, women and lives all on the line.

films.title: Rock'n Roll
films.cast: Guillaume Canet, Marion Cotillard, Gilles Lellouche, Philippe Lefebvre
films.description: Guillaume Canet is told by a young co-star that he's no longer Rock'n' Roll and can't sell films anymore. He then tries to prove her wrong and gets help from his girlfriend, Marion Cotillard.

films.title: Appleseed
films.cast: Ai Kobayashi, Asumi Miwa, Jurota Kosugi, Yuki Matsuoka
films.description: In a utopian society created at the end of the third world war, a female warrior who has been plucked from the badlands begins to see cracks in this new facade. And what does this community have planned for the rest of humankind?

films.title: Dead Birds
films.cast: Henry Thomas, Michael Shannon, Nicki Aycox, Patrick Fugit
films.description: Towards the end of the Civil War a group of Confederate soldiers hole up on an abandoned plantation after robbing a bank, and find themselves at the mercy of supernatural forces.

films.cast: Rachel Weisz, Jude Law, Ben Foster, Anthony Hopkins
films.description: A disparate group of characters unknowingly bond by the sexual choices they make. Consumed by loneliness, a British businessman ponders a rendezvous with a prostitute. The businessman's wife prepares to call it quits with her younger lover. A Brazilian student breaks up with her boyfriend in London. A recovering alcoholic travels to Phoenix in search of his missing daughter. A paroled sex…

films.title: Vincere
films.cast: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Filippo Timi, Corrado Invernizzi, Fausto Russo Alesi
films.description: The story of the descent into madness of Mussolini's secret first wife, Ida Dasler, who was seduced by his passion and vigor but blind to the fascist dictator's many flaws.

films.title: The Art of the Steal
films.cast: Kurt Russell, Matt Dillon, Jay Baruchel, Kenneth Welsh
films.description: Crunch Calhoun, a third-rate motorcycle daredevil and part-time art thief, teams up with his snaky brother to steal one of the most valuable books in the world. But it's not just about the book for Crunch — he's keen to rewrite some chapters of his own past as well.

films.title: Oh Mercy
films.cast: Léa Seydoux, Sara Forestier, Roschdy Zem, Antoine Reinartz
films.description: A police chief in northern France tries to solve a case where an old woman was brutally murdered on Christmas Eve. However, in a neighborhood rife with crime, everyone seems to be a suspect.

films.title: The Perfect Candidate
films.cast: Mila Alzahrani, Nora Al Awadh, Dae Al Hilali, Khalid Abdulrhim
films.description: A young Saudi doctor campaigns for a seat on the municipal council, finding confidence as she combats prejudice.

films.title: The New Adventures of Aladdin
films.cast: Kev Adams, Eric Judor, Jean-Paul Rouve, Vanessa Guide
films.description: A pair of losers working at department store plan to rob the place after it closes. When a bunch of kids show up begging for a story, the men launch into an improvised version of Aladdin.

films.title: Falling for Figaro
films.cast: Danielle Macdonald, Hugh Skinner, Joanna Lumley, Rebecca Benson
films.description: A brilliant young fund manager leaves her unfulfilling job and long-term boyfriend to chase her lifelong dream of becoming an opera singer in the Scottish Highlands.

films.title: Hope
films.cast: Andrea Bræin Hovig, Stellan Skarsgård, Elli Rhiannon Müller Osborne, Daniel Storm Forthun Sandbye
films.description: A couple with a large blended family has grown apart. When the wife is diagnosed with terminal brain cancer, their life breaks down and exposes neglected love.

films.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets Movie
films.cast: Yoshitsugu Matsuoka, Kana Hanazawa, Ayana Taketatsu, Miku Ito
films.description: When five lovely young girls who hate studying hire part-time tutor Futaro, he guides not only their education but also their hearts. Time spent has brought them all closer, with feelings growing within the girls and Futaro. As they finish their third year of high school and their last school festival approaches, they set their sights on what’s next. Is there a future with one of them and Futaro?

films.title: White Bird
films.cast: Ariella Glaser, Orlando Schwerdt, Bryce Gheisar, Gillian Anderson
films.description: Julian Albans, the bully who left Beecher Prep, is visited by his Grandmère from Paris and is transformed by her remarkable story of compassion and courage. As a girl in Nazi-occupied France, the young Grandmère goes into hiding with the help of a schoolmate, a young man who risks everything to give her the chance to survive. Together, they find beauty and love in the secret world of their own…

films.title: The Emperor of Paris
films.cast: Vincent Cassel, Patrick Chesnais, August Diehl, Olga Kurylenko
films.description: Paris, France, early 19th century. The legendary convict François Vidocq lives in disguise trying to escape from a tragic past that torments him. When, after an unfortunate event, he crosses paths with the police chief, he makes a bold decision that will turn the ruthless mastermind of the Parisian underworld against him.

films.title: Reinventing Marvin
films.cast: Finnegan Oldfield, Jules Porier, Catherine Mouchet, Isabelle Huppert
films.description: Telling the true story of Marvin Bijou, a young boy from a working-class family in a small village, who suffers constant bullying at school and home for being ‘different’ – too sensitive and too feminine. A chance encounter with a drama teacher opens the doors to a world that offers him the chance to escape his situation.

films.title: The Last of the Unjust
films.cast: Benjamin Murmelstein, Claude Lanzmann
films.description: A place: Theresienstadt. A unique place of propaganda which Adolf Eichmann called the "model ghetto", designed to mislead the world and Jewish people regarding its real nature, to be the last step before the gas chamber. A man: Benjamin Murmelstein, last president of the Theresienstadt Jewish Council, a fallen hero condemned to exile, who was forced to negotiate day after day from 1938 until the…

films.title: The Hippopotamus
films.cast: Roger Allam, Matthew Modine, Tim McInnerny, Emily Berrington
films.description: Disgraced poet Ted Wallace is summoned to his friend's country manor to investigate a series of unexplained miracles.

films.title: Year of the Horse
films.cast: Neil Young, Ralph Molina, Frank Sampedro, Billy Talbot
films.description: Indie director Jim Jarmusch lenses a low-tech tribute to protean rocker Neil Young and his long-standing band, Crazy Horse. Stitched together from archival material shot in 1976 and 1986 along with candid scenes of Young and the band kicking back between shows, this rockumentary is as ragged as it is direct.

films.title: A Castle in Italy
films.cast: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Louis Garrel, Filippo Timi, Marisa Borini
films.description: Louise meets Nathan, her dreams resurface. It's also the story of her ailing brother, their mother, and the destiny of a leading family of wealthy Italian industrialists. The story of a family falling apart, a world coming to an end and love beginning.

films.title: The Brats
films.cast: Alain Chabat, Max Boublil, Sandrine Kiberlain, Mélanie Bernier
films.description: Newly engaged, Thomas meets his future father-in-law Gilbert, who has been married for 30 years to Suzanne. Disillusioned Gilbert is convinced that his marriage has meant he's missed out on life. He persuades Thomas not to marry his daughter Lola and encourages him to drop everything else in his life as well. The two men then throw themselves into a new brats' life full of adventure, convinced…

films.title: Battle of the Year
films.cast: Josh Holloway, Josh Peck, Chris Brown, Laz Alonso
films.description: A down-on-his-luck coach is hired to prepare a team of the best American dancers for an international tournament that attracts all the best crews from around the world, but the Americans haven't won in fifteen years.

films.title: Days of Darkness
films.cast: Marc Labrèche, Sylvie Léonard, Diane Kruger, Caroline Néron
films.description: Jean-Marc is a man without qualities living in times that are out of joint. His wife and children ignore him; he's a mid-level government functionary in Montreal doing his job without care. He has an active imagination of sexual conquest, but his only real feelings come when he visits his aged mother, whose health is failing. When his wife leaves abruptly to work in Toronto, Jean-Marc sets out to…

films.title: One Man and his Cow
films.cast: Fatsah Bouyahmed, Lambert Wilson, Jamel Debbouze, Julia Piaton
films.description: An Algerian man's life-long dream finally comes true when he receives an invitation to take his cow Jacqueline to the Paris International Agriculture Fair.

films.title: The Best Years of a Life
films.cast: Anouk Aimée, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Antoine Sire, Marianne Denicourt
films.description: They knew each other long ago: a man and a woman whose dazzling and unexpected romance captured in the now-iconic film revolutionized our understanding of love. Today, the former race car driver seems lost in the pathways of his memory. In order to help him, his son seeks out the woman his father wasn’t able to cherish but whom he constantly revisits in his thoughts and dreams. Anne reunites with…

films.title: Playdurizm
films.cast: Gem Deger, Austin Chunn, Issy Stewart, Christopher Hugh James Adamson
films.description: When a teenager finds himself caught in a glitchy-glitzy reality with his onscreen male idol, he does all he can to be possessed by this man and ignore the violent clues of how he got there.

films.title: Dead Weight
films.cast: Benoît Poelvoorde, Gérard Lanvin, José Garcia, Djimon Hounsou
films.description: Prison guard Reggio lets Moltes have a weekly lottery ticket in exchange for his suave relationship advice. When Moltes learns that he has a winning lottery ticket, he breaks out of jail to claim his money. However, Reggio's girlfriend, Pauline , has the ticket with her in Africa. The action involves the odd couple teaming up to find the ticket while being chased by Det. Youssouf , along with the…

films.title: Dragon Rider
films.cast: Thomas Brodie-Sangster, Freddie Highmore, Felicity Jones, Patrick Stewart
films.description: An unlikely trio of heroes – a dragon, a boy and a forest brownie – embark on an epic adventure to find the “Rim of Heaven” - the mythological safe haven for all dragons.

films.title: Thank You, I'm Sorry
films.cast: Sanna Sundqvist, Charlotta Björck, Ia Langhammer, Ville Virtanen
films.description: Suddenly alone during the late stages of her pregnancy, Sara receives an unexpected lifeline when Linda, her estranged older sister, arrives.

films.title: The Children of the Marshland
films.cast: Jacques Villeret, Jacques Gamblin, André Dussollier, Michel Serrault
films.description: The film is set in Marais, a quiet region along the banks of Loire river in 1918. Riton is afflicted with a bad-tempered wife and three unruly children. Garris lives alone with his recollections of World War I trenches. Their daily life consists of seasonal work and visits from their two pals: Tane, the local train conductor and Amédée, a dreamer and voracious reader of classics.

films.title: Elisa
films.cast: Vanessa Paradis, Gérard Depardieu, Clotilde Courau, Sekkou Sall
films.description: Marie has had a tough childhood ever since her mother Elisa committed suicide. She has spent most of her life in an orphanage and now makes a living as a small time criminal in Paris. Now she wants to unravel her past and find her father whom she blames for her mother's death.

films.title: Come Undone
films.cast: Alba Rohrwacher, Pierfrancesco Favino, Giuseppe Battiston, Teresa Saponangelo
films.description: Anna is an accountant for an important insurance firm and lives with her longterm lover Alessio - a man who longs for a stable longterm relationship with children, home, etc. Anna, feeling as though the fire has fizzled in that relationship takes up with co-worker Domenico and the two begin a passionate affair.

films.title: Moomins and the Winter Wonderland
films.cast: Akira Takaki, Oiva Lohtander, Niklas Åkerfelt, Vesa Vierikko
films.description: This winter is extraordinary; Moomintroll decides  to stay awake to explore the winter instead of hibernating as usually. And winters are certainly totally different than he had imagined. Strangest creatures wander amidst the snowdrifts; midwinter darkness surrounds the Moominvalley, and on top of that, an eccentric guest is soon to appear. This guest requires many measures, and is called…

films.title: Stranded: I've Come from a Plane That Crashed on the Mountains
films.cast: José Pedro Algorta Durán, Roberto Canessa, Alfredo Daniel Delgado Salaberri, Daniel Fernández Strauch
films.description: The story, told by the survivors, of a group of young men, members of a Uruguayan rugby team, who managed to survive for 72 days, at an altitude of almost 4,000 meters, in the heart of the Andes Mountains, after their plane, en route to Chile, crashed there on October 13, 1972.

films.title: Conversations with My Gardener
films.cast: Daniel Auteuil, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Fanny Cottençon, Alexia Barlier
films.description: A successful artist, weary of Parisian life and on the verge of divorce, returns to the country to live in his childhood house. He needs someone to make a real vegetable garden again out of the wilderness it has become. The gardener happens to be a former schoolfriend. A warm, fruitful conversation starts between the two men.

films.title: The March on Rome
films.cast: Mark Cousins, Alba Rohrwacher, Donald Trump, Adolf Hitler
films.description: The fascinating story of the rise to power of dictator Benito Mussolini (1883-1945) in Italy in 1922 and how fascism marked the fate of the entire world in the dark years to come.

films.title: Rumba Therapy
films.cast: Franck Dubosc, Louna Espinosa, Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Marie-Philomène Nga
films.description: Tony is a macho middle-aged school bus driver in the provinces with no friends or relations. A sudden heart attack throws him into a tailspin. Tony's convinced he's going to die. When his cardiologist warns him : We all need others. Alone, we're nothing. Tony decides to reconnect with the daughter he abandoned twenty years earlier, when she was just a baby. Still a coward, he's unable to screw up…

films.title: Monster Family 2
films.cast: Emily Watson, Nick Frost, Jessica Brown Findlay, Ethan Rouse
films.description: To free Baba Yaga and Renfield from the clutches of Monster Hunter Mila Starr, the Wishbone Family once more transforms into a Vampire, Frankenstein's Monster, a Mummy and a Werewolf but when aided by their three pet bats, the Monster Family zooms around the world again to save their friends, make new monstrous acquaintances.

films.title: The Ideal Palace
films.cast: Jacques Gamblin, Laetitia Casta, Florence Thomassin, Bernard Le Coq
films.description: Follows Joseph Ferdinand Chavel a French postman who built a palace in the French countryside over 33 years.

films.title: Pil's Adventures
films.cast: Kaycie Chase, Pierre Tessier, Enrique Carballido, Paul Borne
films.description: Pil, a little vagabond girl, lives on the streets of the medieval city of Roc-en-Brume, along with her three tame weasels. She survives of food stolen from the castle of the sinister Regent Tristain. One day, to escape his guards, Pil disguises herself as a princess. Thus she embarks upon a mad, delirious adventure, together with Crobar, a big clumsy guard who thinks she's a noble, and Rigolin, a…

films.title: Odiyan
films.cast: Mohanlal, Manju Warrier, Prakash Raj, Sana Althaf
films.description: With the arrival of electricity in the region under the British rule, the Odiyan clan that possesses the supernatural powers to assume animal form find it difficult to survive as they are ruthlessly captured and killed by the British. How the last Odiyan tries to save his clan with his stealth attacks, forms the crux.

films.title: Brothers of the Wind
films.cast: Manuel Camacho, Jean Reno, Tobias Moretti, Eva Kuen
films.description: The way of the eagle is to raise two chicks. The stronger is destined always to throw the weaker from the nest. Man also has his ways, often to hurt those closest to him.  Lukas suffers at the hands of a father who has withdrawn since the loss of his wife. Killed whilst rescuing the infant Lukas, the boy now carries the burden of her death.  Our eagle’s story begins in the nest. The first-born…

films.title: A Few Less Men
films.cast: Dacre Montgomery, Xavier Samuel, Kris Marshall, Ryan Corr
films.description: Travel plans for three men in ill-fitting wedding tuxedos goes horribly wrong.

films.title: The Inseparables
films.cast: Monica Young, Danny Fehsenfeld, Olivier Paris, Dakota West
films.description: The animated buddy movie follows the misadventures of Don, a runaway puppet with boundless imaginations, and DJ Doggy Dog, an abandoned plush looking for a friend, who cross paths in Central Park and team up against all odds for a epic friendship adventure in New York.

films.title: Italo Disco: The Sparkling Sound of the 80s
films.cast: Jonas Kvarnstrom, Michelangelo La Bionda, Carmelo La Bionda, Sabrina Salerno
films.description: The history of italo disco, a musical genre that conquered the world during the incredible eighties, the most cybernetic decade; a style that was not just another kind of dance-pop music, but also the origin of an aesthetic, a true social phenomenon and the creative center of a very profitable industry.

films.title: Grave of the Fireflies
films.cast: Tsutomu Tatsumi, Ayano Shiraishi, Yoshiko Shinohara, Akemi Yamaguchi
films.description: In the final months of World War II, 14-year-old Seita and his sister Setsuko are orphaned when their mother is killed during an air raid in Kobe, Japan. After a falling out with their aunt, they move into an abandoned bomb shelter. With no surviving relatives and their emergency rations depleted, Seita and Setsuko struggle to survive.

films.title: The Edge of Seventeen
films.cast: Hailee Steinfeld, Woody Harrelson, Haley Lu Richardson, Blake Jenner
films.description: Two high school girls are best friends until one dates the other's older brother, who is totally his sister's nemesis.

films.title: Boogie Nights
films.cast: Mark Wahlberg, Burt Reynolds, Julianne Moore, John C. Reilly
films.description: Set in 1977, back when sex was safe, pleasure was a business and business was booming, idealistic porn producer Jack Horner aspires to elevate his craft to an art form. Horner discovers Eddie Adams, a hot young talent working as a busboy in a nightclub, and welcomes him into the extended family of movie-makers, misfits and hangers-on that are always around. Adams' rise from nobody to a celebrity…

films.title: It's a Wonderful Life
films.cast: James Stewart, Donna Reed, Lionel Barrymore, Thomas Mitchell
films.description: A holiday favourite for generations...  George Bailey has spent his entire life giving to the people of Bedford Falls.  All that prevents rich skinflint Mr. Potter from taking over the entire town is George's modest building and loan company.  But on Christmas Eve the business's $8,000 is lost and George's troubles begin.

films.title: Dogtooth
films.cast: Christos Stergioglou, Michele Valley, Hristos Passalis, Angeliki Papoulia
films.description: Three teenagers are confined to an isolated country estate that could very well be on another planet. The trio spend their days listening to endless homemade tapes that teach them a whole new vocabulary. Any word that comes from beyond their family abode is instantly assigned a new meaning. Hence 'the sea' refers to a large armchair and 'zombies' are little yellow flowers. Having invented a…

films.title: Airplane!
films.cast: Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Leslie Nielsen, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
films.description: Alcoholic pilot, Ted Striker has developed a fear of flying due to wartime trauma, but nevertheless boards a passenger jet in an attempt to woo back his stewardess girlfriend. Food poisoning decimates the passengers and crew, leaving it up to Striker to land the plane with the help of a glue-sniffing air traffic controller and Striker's vengeful former Air Force captain, who must both talk him…

films.title: The King of Comedy
films.cast: Robert De Niro, Jerry Lewis, Sandra Bernhard, Diahnne Déa
films.description: Aspiring comic Rupert Pupkin attempts to achieve success in show business by stalking his idol, a late night talk-show host who craves his own privacy.

films.title: The Sound of Music
films.cast: Julie Andrews, Christopher Plummer, Eleanor Parker, Richard Haydn
films.description: A tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey becomes a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children, and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

films.title: The Craft
films.cast: Robin Tunney, Fairuza Balk, Neve Campbell, Rachel True
films.description: A Catholic school newcomer falls in with a clique of teen witches who wield their powers against all who dare to cross them -- be they teachers, rivals or meddlesome parents.

films.title: The Purge
films.cast: Ethan Hawke, Lena Headey, Max Burkholder, Adelaide Kane
films.description: Given the country's overcrowded prisons, the U.S. government begins to allow 12-hour periods of time in which all illegal activity is legal. During one of these free-for-alls, a family must protect themselves from a home invasion.

films.title: Waves
films.cast: Kelvin Harrison Jr., Taylor Russell, Renée Elise Goldsberry, Sterling K. Brown
films.description: A controlling father’s attempts to ensure that his two children succeed in high school backfire after his son experiences a career-ending sports injury. Their familial bonds are eventually placed under severe strain by an unexpected tragedy.

films.title: Adaptation.
films.cast: Nicolas Cage, Meryl Streep, Chris Cooper, Tilda Swinton
films.description: A love-lorn script writer grows increasingly desperate in his quest to adapt the book 'The Orchid Thief'.

films.title: Natural Born Killers
films.cast: Woody Harrelson, Juliette Lewis, Robert Downey Jr., Tommy Lee Jones
films.description: Two victims of traumatized childhoods become lovers and psychopathic serial murderers irresponsibly glorified by the mass media.

films.title: Panic Room
films.cast: Jodie Foster, Kristen Stewart, Forest Whitaker, Dwight Yoakam
films.description: Trapped in their New York brownstone's panic room, a hidden chamber built as a sanctuary in the event of break-ins, newly divorced Meg Altman and her young daughter Sarah play a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with three intruders - Burnham, Raoul and Junior - during a brutal home invasion. But the room itself is the focal point because what the intruders really want is inside it.

films.title: The Thin Red Line
films.cast: Jim Caviezel, Ben Chaplin, Dash Mihok, Woody Harrelson
films.description: The story of a group of men, an Army Rifle company called C-for-Charlie, who change, suffer, and ultimately make essential discoveries about themselves during the fierce World War II battle of Guadalcanal. It follows their journey, from the surprise of an unopposed landing, through the bloody and exhausting battles that follow, to the ultimate departure of those who survived.

films.title: A Fistful of Dollars
films.cast: Clint Eastwood, Marianne Koch, Gian Maria Volonté, Wolfgang Lukschy
films.description: The Man With No Name enters the Mexican village of San Miguel in the midst of a power struggle among the three Rojo brothers and sheriff John Baxter. When a regiment of Mexican soldiers bearing gold intended to pay for new weapons is waylaid by the Rojo brothers, the stranger inserts himself into the middle of the long-simmering battle, selling false information to both sides for his own benefit.

films.title: Cruel Intentions
films.cast: Ryan Phillippe, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Reese Witherspoon, Selma Blair
films.description: Slaking a thirst for dangerous games, Kathryn challenges her stepbrother, Sebastian, to deflower their headmaster's daughter before the summer ends. If he succeeds, the prize is the chance to bed Kathryn. But if he loses, Kathryn will claim his most prized possession.

films.title: Anastasia
films.cast: Meg Ryan, John Cusack, Kelsey Grammer, Christopher Lloyd
films.description: This animated adventure retells the story of the lost daughter of Russia's last czar. The evil Rasputin places a curse on the Romanov family, and Anastasia and her grandmother, Empress Maria, get separated. After growing up in an orphanage, Anastasia encounters two Russian men seeking a reward offered by Empress Maria for the return of her granddaughter. The trio travels to Paris, where they find…

films.title: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
films.cast: Carmen Maura, Antonio Banderas, Julieta Serrano, María Barranco
films.description: Pepa resolves to kill herself with a batch of sleeping-pill-laced gazpacho after her lover leaves her. Fortunately, she is interrupted by a deliciously chaotic series of events.

films.title: The Holy Mountain
films.cast: Alejandro Jodorowsky, Horacio Salinas, Zamira Saunders, Juan Ferrara
films.description: A Mexican master leads a Christ figure and other disciples to a mountain of immortal wise men.  The scandal of the 1973 Cannes Film Festival, writer/director Alejandro Jodorowsky's flood of sacrilegious imagery and existential symbolism in The Holy Mountain is a spiritual quest for enlightenment pitting illusion against truth. The Alchemist (Jodorowsky) assembles together a group of people from…

films.title: Begin Again
films.cast: Mark Ruffalo, Keira Knightley, Adam Levine, Hailee Steinfeld
films.description: A long-lost music producer finds a singer-songwriter right about the moment he has given up all hope on life.

films.title: Wild Strawberries
films.cast: Victor Sjöström, Bibi Andersson, Ingrid Thulin, Gunnar Björnstrand
films.description: Crotchety retired doctor Isak Borg travels from Stockholm to Lund, Sweden, with his pregnant and unhappy daughter-in-law, Marianne, in order to receive an honorary degree from his alma mater. Along the way, they encounter a series of hitchhikers, each of whom causes the elderly doctor to muse upon the pleasures and failures of his own life. These include the vivacious young Sara, a dead ringer…

films.title: Le Samouraï
films.cast: Alain Delon, François Périer, Nathalie Delon, Cathy Rosier
films.description: After carrying out a flawlessly planned hit, Jef Costello, a contract killer with samurai instincts, finds himself caught between a persistent police investigator and a ruthless employer, and not even his armor of fedora and trench coat can protect him.

films.title: Drag Me to Hell
films.cast: Alison Lohman, Justin Long, Lorna Raver, Dileep Rao
films.description: After denying a woman the extension she needs to keep her home, loan officer Christine Brown sees her once-promising life take a startling turn for the worse. Christine is convinced she's been cursed by a Gypsy, but her boyfriend is skeptical. Her only hope seems to lie in a psychic who claims he can help her lift the curse and keep her soul from being dragged straight to hell.

films.title: Never Rarely Sometimes Always
films.cast: Sidney Flanigan, Talia Ryder, Théodore Pellerin, Ryan Eggold
films.description: A pair of teenage girls in rural Pennsylvania travel to New York City to seek out medical help after an unintended pregnancy.

films.title: Mary and Max
films.cast: Toni Collette, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Barry Humphries, Eric Bana
films.description: A tale of friendship between two unlikely pen pals: Mary, a lonely, eight-year-old girl living in the suburbs of Melbourne, and Max, a forty-four-year old, severely obese man living in New York. In the mid-1970's, a homely, friendless Australian girl of 8 picks a name out of a Manhattan phone book and writes to him; she includes a chocolate bar. He writes back, with chocolate. Thus begins a…

films.title: Only Yesterday
films.cast: Miki Imai, Toshiro Yanagiba, Yoko Honna, Mayumi Izuka
films.description: It’s 1982, and Taeko is 27 years old, unmarried, and has lived her whole life in Tokyo. She decides to visit her family in the countryside, and as the train travels through the night, memories flood back of her younger years: the first immature stirrings of romance, the onset of puberty, and the frustrations of math and boys. At the station she is met by young farmer Toshio, and the encounters…

films.title: Watcher
films.cast: Maika Monroe, Karl Glusman, Burn Gorman, Mãdãlina Anea
films.description: As a serial killer stalks the city, Julia — a young actress who just moved to town with her husband — notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.

films.title: Saw VI
films.cast: Tobin Bell, Costas Mandylor, Mark Rolston, Betsy Russell
films.description: Special Agent Strahm is dead, and Detective Hoffman has emerged as the unchallenged successor to Jigsaw's legacy. However, when the FBI draws closer to Hoffman, he is forced to set a game into motion, and Jigsaw's grand scheme is finally understood.

films.title: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
films.cast: Matt Damon, James Cromwell, Charles Napier, Robert Cait
films.description: As a wild stallion travels across the frontiers of the Old West, he befriends a young human and finds true love with a mare.

films.title: Letters to Juliet
films.cast: Amanda Seyfried, Christopher Egan, Gael García Bernal, Vanessa Redgrave
films.description: An American girl on vacation in Italy finds an unanswered "letter to Juliet" -- one of thousands of missives left at the fictional lover's Verona courtyard, which are typically answered by a the "secretaries of Juliet" -- and she goes on a quest to find the lovers referenced in the letter.

films.title: Happiness
films.cast: Jane Adams, Jon Lovitz, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Dylan Baker
films.description: The lives of many individuals connected by the desire for happiness, often from sources usually considered dark or evil.

films.title: Spiderhead
films.cast: Chris Hemsworth, Miles Teller, Jurnee Smollett, Mark Paguio
films.description: A prisoner in a state-of-the-art penitentiary begins to question the purpose of the emotion-controlling drugs he's testing for a pharmaceutical genius.

films.title: James and the Giant Peach
films.cast: Paul Terry, Miriam Margolyes, Joanna Lumley, Pete Postlethwaite
films.description: When the young orphan boy James spills a magic bag of crocodile tongues, he finds himself in possession of a giant peach that flies him away to strange lands.

films.title: Touch of Evil
films.cast: Charlton Heston, Janet Leigh, Orson Welles, Joseph Calleia
films.description: When a car bomb explodes on the American side of the U.S./Mexico border, Mexican drug enforcement agent Miguel Vargas begins his investigation, along with American police captain Hank Quinlan. When Vargas begins to suspect that Quinlan and his shady partner, Menzies, are planting evidence to frame an innocent man, his investigations into their possible corruption quickly put himself and his new…

films.title: Wildlife
films.cast: Jake Gyllenhaal, Carey Mulligan, Ed Oxenbould, Zoe Colletti
films.description: 14-year-old Joe is the only child of Jeanette and Jerry — a housewife and a golf pro — in a small town in 1960s Montana. Nearby, an uncontrolled forest fire rages close to the Canadian border, and when Jerry loses his job (and his sense of purpose) he decides to join the cause of fighting the fire, leaving his wife and son to fend for themselves.

films.title: Marrowbone
films.cast: George MacKay, Anya Taylor-Joy, Charlie Heaton, Mia Goth
films.description: A young man and his three younger siblings are plagued by a sinister presence in the sprawling manor in which they live.

films.title: Anatomy of a Murder
films.cast: James Stewart, Lee Remick, Ben Gazzara, Arthur O'Connell
films.description: Semi-retired Michigan lawyer Paul Biegler takes the case of Army Lt. Manion, who murdered a local innkeeper after his wife claimed that he raped her. Over the course of an extensive trial, Biegler parries with District Attorney Lodwick and out-of-town prosecutor Claude Dancer to set his client free, but his case rests on the victim's mysterious business partner, who's hiding a dark secret.

films.title: Ocean Waves
films.cast: Nobuo Tobita, Youko Sakamoto, Toshihiko Seki, Yuri Amano
films.description: At Kichijōji Station, Tokyo, Taku Morisaki glimpses a familiar woman on the platform opposite boarding a train. Later, her photo falls from a shelf as he exits his apartment before flying to Kōchi Prefecture. Picking it up, he looks at it briefly before leaving. As the aeroplane takes off he narrates the events that brought her into his life...

films.title: Paper Towns
films.cast: Nat Wolff, Cara Delevingne, Austin Abrams, Justice Smith
films.description: Quentin Jacobsen has spent a lifetime loving the magnificently adventurous Margo Roth Spiegelman from afar. So when she cracks open a window and climbs back into his life-dressed like a ninja and summoning him for an ingenious campaign of revenge-he follows. After their all-nighter ends and a new day breaks, Q arrives at school to discover that Margo, always an enigma, has now become a mystery.…

films.title: Planet Terror
films.cast: Rose McGowan, Freddy Rodríguez, Marley Shelton, Josh Brolin
films.description: Two doctors find their graveyard shift inundated with townspeople ravaged by sores. Among the wounded is Cherry, a dancer whose leg was ripped from her body. As the invalids quickly become enraged aggressors, Cherry and her ex-boyfriend Wray lead a team of accidental warriors into the night.

films.title: Milk
films.cast: Sean Penn, Emile Hirsch, Josh Brolin, Diego Luna
films.description: The true story of Harvey Milk, the first openly gay man ever elected to public office. In San Francisco in the late 1970s, Harvey Milk becomes an activist for gay rights and inspires others to join him in his fight for equal rights that should be available to all Americans.

films.title: L'Avventura
films.cast: Monica Vitti, Lea Massari, Gabriele Ferzetti, Dominique Blanchar
films.description: Claudia and Anna join Anna's lover, Sandro, on a boat trip to a remote volcanic island. When Anna goes missing, a search is launched. In the meantime, Sandro and Claudia become involved in a romance despite Anna's disappearance, though the relationship suffers from guilt and tension.

films.title: Spy Kids 3-D: Game Over
films.cast: Daryl Sabara, Ricardo Montalban, Alexa PenaVega, Sylvester Stallone
films.description: Carmen's caught in a virtual reality game designed by the Kids' new nemesis, the Toymaker. It's up to Juni to save his sister, and ultimately the world.

films.title: Leave No Trace
films.cast: Thomasin McKenzie, Ben Foster, Jeff Kober, Dale Dickey
films.description: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Oregon, rarely making contact with the world. But when a small mistake tips them off to authorities, they are sent on an increasingly erratic journey in search of a place to call their own.

films.title: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride
films.cast: Matthew Broderick, Neve Campbell, Jason Marsden, Nathan Lane
films.description: The circle of life continues for Simba, now fully grown and in his rightful place as the king of Pride Rock. Simba and Nala have given birth to a daughter, Kiara who's as rebellious as her father was. But Kiara drives her parents to distraction when she catches the eye of Kovu, the son of the evil lioness, Zira. Will Kovu steal Kiara's heart?

films.title: Gnomeo & Juliet
films.cast: James McAvoy, Emily Blunt, Michael Caine, Maggie Smith
films.description: A version of Shakespeare's play, set in the world of warring indoor and outdoor gnomes. Garden gnomes Gnomeo and Juliet have as many obstacles to overcome as their quasi namesakes when they are caught up in a feud between neighbors. But with plastic pink flamingos and lawnmower races in the mix, can this young couple find lasting happiness?

films.title: What's Your Number?
films.cast: Anna Faris, Chris Evans, Ari Graynor, Blythe Danner
films.description: Ally Darling is realizing she's a little lost in life. Her latest romance has just fizzled out, and she's just been fired from her marketing job. Then she reads an eye-opening magazine article that warns that 96 percent of women who've been with 20 or more lovers are unlikely to find a husband. Determined to turn her life around and prove the article wrong, Ally embarks on a mission to find the…

films.title: The Way He Looks
films.cast: Ghilherme Lobo, Fábio Audi, Tess Amorim, Lúcia Romano
films.description: Leonardo is a blind teenager dealing with an overprotective mother while trying to live a more independent life. To the disappointment of his best friend, Giovana, he plans to go on an exchange program abroad. When Gabriel, a new student in town, arrives at their classroom, new feelings blossom in Leonardo making him question his plans.

films.title: Precious
films.cast: Gabourey Sidibe, Mo'Nique, Paula Patton, Mariah Carey
films.description: Set in Harlem in 1987, Claireece "Precious" Jones is a 16-year-old African American girl born into a life no one would want. She's pregnant for the second time by her absent father; at home, she must wait hand and foot on her mother, an angry woman who abuses her emotionally and physically. School is chaotic and Precious has reached the ninth grade with good marks and a secret--she can't read.

films.title: The Double
films.cast: Jesse Eisenberg, Mia Wasikowska, Wallace Shawn, Yasmin Paige
films.description: An awkward office drone becomes increasingly unhinged after a charismatic and confident look-alike takes a job at his workplace and seduces the woman he desires.

films.title: The Gold Rush
films.cast: Charlie Chaplin, Georgia Hale, Mack Swain, Tom Murray
films.description: A lone prospector ventures into Alaska looking for gold. He gets mixed up with some burly characters and falls in love with the beautiful Georgia. He tries to win her heart with his singular charm.

films.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
films.cast: Jim Carrey, Ian McNeice, Simon Callow, Maynard Eziashi
films.description: Summoned from an ashram in Tibet, Ace finds himself on a perilous journey into the jungles of Africa to find Shikaka, the missing sacred animal of the friendly Wachati tribe. He must accomplish this before the wedding of the Wachati's Princess to the prince of the warrior Wachootoos. If Ace fails, the result will be a vicious tribal war.

films.title: Boys Don't Cry
films.cast: Hilary Swank, Chloë Sevigny, Peter Sarsgaard, Brendan Sexton III
films.description: Female born, Teena Brandon adopts his male identity of Brandon Teena and attempts to find himself and love in Nebraska.

films.title: What Happens in Vegas
films.cast: Cameron Diaz, Ashton Kutcher, Rob Corddry, Lake Bell
films.description: During a wild vacation in Las Vegas, career woman Joy McNally and playboy Jack Fuller come to the sober realization that they have married each other after a night of drunken abandon. They are then compelled, for legal reasons, to live life as a couple for a limited period of time. At stake is a large amount of money.

films.title: Leo
films.cast: Adam Sandler, Bill Burr, Cecily Strong, Jason Alexander
films.description: Jaded 74-year-old lizard Leo has been stuck in the same Florida classroom for decades with his terrarium-mate turtle. When he learns he only has one year left to live, he plans to escape to experience life on the outside but instead gets caught up in the problems of his anxious students — including an impossibly mean substitute teacher.

films.title: Shaolin Soccer
films.cast: Stephen Chow, Zhao Wei, Ng Man-tat, Patrick Tse Yin
films.description: A young Shaolin follower reunites with his discouraged brothers to form a soccer team using their martial art skills to their advantage.

films.title: Biutiful
films.cast: Javier Bardem, Maricel Álvarez, Hanaa Bouchaib, Guillermo Estrella
films.description: This is a story of a man in free fall. On the road to redemption, darkness lights his way. Connected with the afterlife, Uxbal is a tragic hero and father of two who's sensing the danger of death. He struggles with a tainted reality and a fate that works against him in order to forgive, for love, and forever.

films.title: Robin Hood: Men in Tights
films.cast: Cary Elwes, Richard Lewis, Roger Rees, Amy Yasbeck
films.description: Robin Hood comes home after fighting in the Crusades to learn that the noble King Richard is in exile and that the despotic King John now rules England, with the help of the Sheriff of Rottingham. Robin Hood assembles a band of fellow patriots to do battle with King John and the Sheriff.

films.title: Magic Mike XXL
films.cast: Channing Tatum, Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello, Kevin Nash
films.description: Three years after Mike bowed out of the stripper life at the top of his game, he and the remaining Kings of Tampa hit the road to Myrtle Beach to put on one last blow-out performance.

films.title: Brüno
films.cast: Sacha Baron Cohen, Gustaf Hammarsten, Clifford Bañagale, Josh Meyers
films.description: Flamboyantly gay Austrian television reporter Bruno stirs up trouble with unsuspecting guests and large crowds through brutally frank interviews and painfully hilarious public displays of homosexuality.

films.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
films.cast: Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Charles Napier, Steven Berkoff
films.description: John Rambo is released from prison by the government for a top-secret covert mission to the last place on Earth he'd want to return - the jungles of Vietnam.

films.title: Willow
films.cast: Warwick Davis, Val Kilmer, Joanne Whalley, Jean Marsh
films.description: Fearful of a prophecy stating that a girl child will be born to bring about her downfall, the evil Queen Bavmorda imprisons all pregnant women within the formidable stronghold of Nockmaar. A child, Elora Danan, is born in the Nockmaar dungeons and identified as the prophesied child by a birthmark on her arm. However, before the black sorceress arrives to claim the child, Elora's mother convinces…

films.title: Apollo 10½:  A Space Age Childhood
films.cast: Milo Coy, Jack Black, Lee Eddy, Bill Wise
films.description: A man narrates stories of his life as a 10-year-old boy in 1969 Houston, weaving tales of nostalgia with a fantastical account of a journey to the moon.

films.title: The Unforgivable
films.cast: Sandra Bullock, Viola Davis, Vincent D'Onofrio, Jon Bernthal
films.description: A woman is released from prison after serving a sentence for a violent crime and re-enters a society that refuses to forgive her past.

films.title: Unfriended: Dark Web
films.cast: Colin Woodell, Betty Gabriel, Rebecca Rittenhouse, Andrew Lees
films.description: ​When a 20-something finds a cache of hidden files on his new laptop, he and his friends are unwittingly thrust into the depths of the dark web. They soon discover someone has been watching their every move and will go to unimaginable lengths to protect the dark web.

films.title: Sleeping with Other People
films.cast: Jason Sudeikis, Alison Brie, Adam Scott, Jason Mantzoukas
films.description: Can two serial cheaters get a second chance at love? After a one-night stand in college, New Yorkers Lainey and Jake meet by chance twelve years later and discover they each have the same problem: because of their monogamy-challenged ways, neither can maintain a relationship. Determined to stay friends despite their mutual attraction, they make a pact to keep it platonic, a deal that proves…

films.title: I Am Mother
films.cast: Clara Rugaard, Rose Byrne, Hilary Swank, Luke Hawker
films.description: A teenage girl is raised underground by a robot "Mother", designed to repopulate the earth following an extinction event. But their unique bond is threatened when an inexplicable stranger arrives with alarming news.

films.title: Let Me In
films.cast: Kodi Smit-McPhee, Chloë Grace Moretz, Richard Jenkins, Elias Koteas
films.description: A bullied young boy befriends a young female vampire who lives in secrecy with her guardian.  A remake of the movie “Let The Right One In” which was an adaptation of a book.

films.title: Zack and Miri Make a Porno
films.cast: Elizabeth Banks, Seth Rogen, Craig Robinson, Gerry Bednob
films.description: Lifelong platonic friends Zack and Miri look to solve their respective cash-flow problems by making an adult film together. As the cameras roll, however, the duo begin to sense that they may have more feelings for each other than they previously thought.

films.title: In Fabric
films.cast: Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Sidse Babett Knudsen, Julian Barratt, Richard Bremmer
films.description: A haunting ghost story set against the backdrop of a busy winter sales period in a department store, following the life of a cursed dress as it passes from person to person, with devastating consequences.

films.title: The Motorcycle Diaries
films.cast: Gael García Bernal, Rodrigo de la Serna, Mercedes Morán, Mía Maestro
films.description: Based on the journals of Che Guevara, leader of the Cuban Revolution. In his memoirs, Guevara recounts adventures he and best friend Alberto Granado had while crossing South America by motorcycle in the early 1950s.

films.title: I Love You Phillip Morris
films.cast: Jim Carrey, Ewan McGregor, Leslie Mann, Rodrigo Santoro
films.description: Steve Russell is a small-town cop. Bored with his bland lifestyle, Russell turns to fraud as a means of shaking things up. Before long, Russell's criminal antics have landed him behind bars, where he encounters the charismatic Phillip Morris. Smitten, Russell devotes his entire life to being with Morris regardless of the consequences.

films.title: The People Under the Stairs
films.cast: Brandon Quintin Adams, Everett McGill, Wendy Robie, A.J. Langer
films.description: When young Poindexter "Fool" Williams breaks into the creepy, immense old home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he uncovers a disturbing scenario underneath the stairs.

films.title: Curse of Chucky
films.cast: Fiona Dourif, Brad Dourif, Danielle Bisutti, Summer H. Howell
films.description: After the passing of her mother, Nica Pierce, a young woman in a wheelchair, is forced to deal with her sister, brother-in-law, niece and their nanny as they say their goodbyes to mother. But when people start turning up dead, Nica discovers the culprit might be a strange doll she received a few days earlier.

films.title: It's Complicated
films.cast: Meryl Streep, Steve Martin, Alec Baldwin, John Krasinski
films.description: Ten years after their divorce, Jane and Jake Adler unite for their son's college graduation and unexpectedly end up sleeping together. But Jake is married, and Jane is embarking on a new romance with her architect. Now, she has to sort out her life—just when she thought she had it all figured out.

films.title: Octopussy
films.cast: Roger Moore, Maud Adams, Louis Jourdan, Kristina Wayborn
films.description: James Bond is sent to investigate after a fellow “00” agent is found dead with a priceless Fabergé egg. Bond follows the mystery and uncovers a smuggling scandal and a Russian General who wants to provoke a new World War.

films.title: Horns
films.cast: Daniel Radcliffe, Juno Temple, Max Minghella, Joe Anderson
films.description: In the aftermath of his girlfriend's mysterious death, a young man awakens to strange horns sprouting from his temples.

films.title: The Crazies
films.cast: Timothy Olyphant, Radha Mitchell, Joe Anderson, Danielle Panabaker
films.description: Four friends find themselves trapped in their small hometown after they discover their friends and neighbors going quickly and horrifically insane.

films.title: The Men Who Stare at Goats
films.cast: George Clooney, Ewan McGregor, Jeff Bridges, Kevin Spacey
films.description: A reporter in Iraq might just have the story of a lifetime when he meets Lyn Cassady, a guy who claims to be a former member of the U.S. Army's New Earth Army, a unit that employs paranormal powers in their missions.

films.title: Romancing the Stone
films.cast: Michael Douglas, Kathleen Turner, Danny DeVito, Zack Norman
films.description: Though she can spin wild tales of passionate romance, novelist Joan Wilder has no life of her own. Then one day adventure comes her way in the form of a mysterious package. It turns out that the parcel is the ransom she'll need to free her abducted sister, so Joan flies to South America to hand it over. But she gets on the wrong bus and winds up hopelessly stranded in the jungle.

films.title: Renaissance: A Film by Beyoncé
films.cast: Beyoncé, Jay-Z, Blue Ivy Carter, Sir Carter
films.description: Accentuates the journey of Renaissance World Tour, from its inception, to the opening in Stockholm, Sweden, to the finale in Kansas City, Missouri. It is about Beyoncé’s intention, hard work, involvement in every aspect of the production, her creative mind and purpose to create her legacy, and master her craft. Received with extraordinary acclaim, Beyoncé’s Renaissance World Tour created a…

films.title: Sex and the City 2
films.cast: Sarah Jessica Parker, Kim Cattrall, Kristin Davis, Cynthia Nixon
films.description: Carrie, Charlotte, and Miranda are all married now, but they're still up for a little fun in the sun. When Samantha gets the chance to visit one of the most extravagant vacation destinations on the planet and offers to bring them all along, they surmise that a women-only retreat may be the perfect excuse to eschew their responsibilities and remember what life was like before they decided to…

films.title: Sinbad: Legend of the Seven Seas
films.cast: Brad Pitt, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Michelle Pfeiffer, Joseph Fiennes
films.description: The sailor of legend is framed by the goddess Eris for the theft of the Book of Peace, and must travel to her realm at the end of the world to retrieve it and save the life of his childhood friend Prince Proteus.

films.title: Dog
films.cast: Channing Tatum, Aavi Haas, Ryder McLaughlin, Luke Forbes
films.description: An army ranger and his dog embark on a road trip along the Pacific Coast Highway to attend a friend's funeral.

films.title: Texas Chainsaw 3D
films.cast: Alexandra Daddario, Dan Yeager, Trey Songz, Tania Raymonde
films.description: A young woman learns that she has inherited a Texas estate from her deceased grandmother. After embarking on a road trip with friends to uncover her roots, she finds she is the sole owner of a lavish, isolated Victorian mansion. But her newfound wealth comes at a price as she stumbles upon a horror that awaits her in the mansion’s dank cellars.

films.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
films.cast: Scarlett Johansson, Colin Firth, Tom Wilkinson, Cillian Murphy
films.description: This film, adapted from a work of fiction by author Tracy Chevalier, tells a story about the events surrounding the creation of the painting "Girl With A Pearl Earring" by 17th century Dutch master Johannes Vermeer. A young peasant maid working in the house of painter Johannes Vermeer becomes his talented assistant and the model for one of his most famous works.

films.title: Frost/Nixon
films.cast: Michael Sheen, Frank Langella, Kevin Bacon, Sam Rockwell
films.description: For three years after being forced from office, Nixon remained silent. But in summer 1977, the steely, cunning former commander-in-chief agreed to sit for one all-inclusive interview to confront the questions of his time in office and the Watergate scandal that ended his presidency. Nixon surprised everyone in selecting Frost as his televised confessor, intending to easily outfox the breezy…

films.title: Magic in the Moonlight
films.cast: Colin Firth, Emma Stone, Hamish Linklater, Marcia Gay Harden
films.description: Set in the 1920s French Riviera, a master magician is commissioned to try and expose a psychic as a fraud.

films.title: Come to Daddy
films.cast: Elijah Wood, Stephen McHattie, Michael Smiley, Madeleine Sami
films.description: After receiving a cryptic letter from his estranged father, Norval travels to his dad’s oceanfront home for what he hopes will be a positive experience. If only he’d known the dark truth about his old man beforehand.

films.title: Suffragette
films.cast: Carey Mulligan, Helena Bonham Carter, Brendan Gleeson, Anne-Marie Duff
films.description: Based on true events about the foot soldiers of the early feminist movement who were forced underground to evade the State.

films.title: An Extremely Goofy Movie
films.cast: Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden, Jeff Bennett, Jim Cummings
films.description: It's all extreme sports and a life of freedom as Max sets off for college -- but Goofy misses Max so much he loses his job and goes to finish college alongside Max and his friends. But as Goofy tries to get closer to Max, both must go to the extreme to learn how to live their own lives together.

films.title: Good Grief
films.cast: Dan Levy, Ruth Negga, Himesh Patel, Luke Evans
films.description: When his husband unexpectedly dies, Marc's world shatters, sending him and his two best friends on a soul-searching trip to Paris that reveals some hard truths they each needed to face.

films.title: Sometimes I Think About Dying
films.cast: Daisy Ridley, Dave Merheje, Parvesh Cheena, Marcia DeBonis
films.description: Fran likes to think about dying. It brings sensation to her quiet life. When she makes the new guy at work laugh, it leads to more: a date, a slice of pie, a conversation, a spark. The only thing standing in their way is Fran herself.

films.title: Good Night, and Good Luck.
films.cast: David Strathairn, Patricia Clarkson, George Clooney, Jeff Daniels
films.description: The story of journalist Edward R. Murrow's stand against Senator Joseph McCarthy's anti-communist witch-hunts in the early 1950s.

films.title: Shot Caller
films.cast: Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Omari Hardwick, Jon Bernthal, Lake Bell
films.description: A newly-released prison gangster is forced by the leaders of his gang to orchestrate a major crime with a brutal rival gang on the streets of Southern California.

films.title: The Assassin
films.cast: Shu Qi, Chang Chen, Nikki Hsieh, Sheu Fang-Yi
films.description: A female assassin during the Tang Dynasty who begins to question her loyalties when she falls in love with one of her targets.

films.title: Pauline at the Beach
films.cast: Amanda Langlet, Arielle Dombasle, Pascal Greggory, Féodor Atkine
films.description: Marion is about to divorce from her husband and takes her 15-year-old niece, Pauline, on a vacation to Granville. There, she meets an old love...

films.title: Loving
films.cast: Joel Edgerton, Ruth Negga, Michael Shannon, Marton Csokas
films.description: The story of Richard and Mildred Loving, an interracial couple, whose challenge of their anti-miscegenation arrest for their marriage in Virginia led to a legal battle that would end at the US Supreme Court.

films.title: You Again
films.cast: Kristen Bell, Jamie Lee Curtis, Sigourney Weaver, Odette Annable
films.description: History -- make that high school -- may repeat itself when Marni learns that Joanna, the mean girl from her past, is set to be her sister-in-law. Before the wedding bells toll, Marni must show her brother that a tiger doesn't change its stripes. On Marni's side is her mother, while Joanna's backed by her wealthy aunt.

films.title: Death Race
films.cast: Jason Statham, Joan Allen, Ian McShane, Tyrese Gibson
films.description: Terminal Island, New York: 2020. Overcrowding in the US penal system has reached a breaking point. Prisons have been turned over to a monolithic Weyland Corporation, which sees jails full of thugs as an opportunity for televised sport. Adrenalized inmates, a global audience hungry for violence and a spectacular, enclosed arena come together to form the 'Death Race', the biggest, most brutal event.

films.title: The Wife
films.cast: Glenn Close, Jonathan Pryce, Christian Slater, Max Irons
films.description: A wife questions her life choices as she travels to Stockholm with her husband, where he is slated to receive the Nobel Prize for Literature.

films.title: Couples Retreat
films.cast: Vince Vaughn, Jason Bateman, Jon Favreau, Faizon Love
films.description: Four couples, all friends, descend on a tropical island resort. Though one husband and wife are there to work on their marriage, the others just want to enjoy some fun in the sun. They soon find, however, that paradise comes at a price: Participation in couples therapy sessions is mandatory. What started out as a cut-rate vacation turns into an examination of the common problems many face.

films.title: Shadow
films.cast: Deng Chao, Sun Li, Ryan Zheng Kai, Wang Qian-Yuan
films.description: In a kingdom ruled by a young and unpredictable king, the military commander has a secret weapon: a shadow, a look-alike who can fool both his enemies and the King himself. Now he must use this weapon in an intricate plan that will lead his people to victory in a war that the King does not want.

films.title: The Legend of Zorro
films.cast: Antonio Banderas, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Adrian Alonso, Julio Oscar Mechoso
films.description: Having spent the last 10 years fighting injustice and cruelty, Alejandro de la Vega is now facing his greatest challenge: his loving wife Elena has thrown him out of the house!  Elena has filed for divorce and found comfort in the arms of Count Armand, a dashing French aristocrat.  But Alejandro knows something she doesn't: Armand is the evil mastermind behind a terrorist plot to destroy the…

films.title: Let Them All Talk
films.cast: Meryl Streep, Lucas Hedges, Gemma Chan, Dianne Wiest
films.description: A celebrated author takes a journey with some old friends to have some fun and heal old wounds. Her nephew comes along to wrangle the ladies and finds himself involved with a young literary agent.

films.title: Europa
films.cast: Jean-Marc Barr, Barbara Sukowa, Udo Kier, Ernst-Hugo Järegård
films.description: Postwar Germany, 1945. Leopold Kessler, an American of German descent, works as a sleeping car conductor for the Zentropa railway line. When he meets Katharina Hartmann, the railroad owner's daughter, and they fall in love, his life intersects with the dark and violent path of a mysterious organization opposed to the United States army military occupation.

films.title: Every Day
films.cast: Angourie Rice, Justice Smith, Debby Ryan, Maria Bello
films.description: 16-year old Rhiannon falls in love with a mysterious spirit named “A” that inhabits a different body every day. Feeling an unmatched connection, Rhiannon and “A” work each day to find each other, not knowing what the next day will bring.

films.title: Departures
films.cast: Masahiro Motoki, Ryoko Hirosue, Tsutomu Yamazaki, Kazuko Yoshiyuki
films.description: Daigo, a cellist, is laid off from his orchestra and moves with his wife back to his small hometown where the living is cheaper. Thinking he’s applying for a job at a travel agency he finds he’s being interviewed for work with departures of a more permanent nature – as an undertaker’s assistant.

films.title: Never Say Never Again
films.cast: Sean Connery, Klaus Maria Brandauer, Max von Sydow, Barbara Carrera
