films.description: In 1950s Connecticut, a housewife faces a marital crisis and mounting racial tensions in the outside world.

films.title: Letters from Iwo Jima
films.cast: Ken Watanabe, Kazunari Ninomiya, Tsuyoshi Ihara, Ryo Kase
films.description: The story of the battle of Iwo Jima between the United States and Imperial Japan during World War II, as told from the perspective of the Japanese who fought it.

films.title: Wild Wild West
films.cast: Will Smith, Kevin Kline, Kenneth Branagh, Salma Hayek Pinault
films.description: Legless Southern inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless plans to rekindle the Civil War by assassinating President U.S. Grant. Only two men can stop him: gunfighter James West and master-of-disguise and inventor Artemus Gordon. The two must team up to thwart Loveless' plans.

films.title: Shivers
films.cast: Paul Hampton, Joe Silver, Lynn Lowry, Allan Kolman
films.description: The residents of a suburban high-rise apartment building are being infected by a strain of parasites that turn them into mindless, sex-crazed fiends out to infect others by the slightest sexual contact.

films.title: Dangerous Liaisons
films.cast: Glenn Close, John Malkovich, Michelle Pfeiffer, Swoosie Kurtz
films.description: In 18th century France, Marquise de Merteuil asks her ex-lover Vicomte de Valmont to seduce the future wife of another ex-lover of hers in return for one last night with her. Yet things don’t go as planned.

films.title: Piggy
films.cast: Laura Galán, Richard Holmes, Carmen Machi, Irene Ferreiro
films.description: A bullied overweight teenager sees a glimpse of hope when her tormentors are brutally abducted by a mesmerizing stranger.

films.title: Failure to Launch
films.cast: Matthew McConaughey, Sarah Jessica Parker, Zooey Deschanel, Justin Bartha
films.description: Tripp, an attractive man in his thirties, is still living with his parents Al and Sue. Tripp's best friends Demo and Ace are also still living in their parents' homes and seem proud of it. Al and Sue are not happy, however, and are fascinated when friends whose adult son has recently moved away from home reveal they hired an expert to arrange the matter and couldn't be happier with the result.

films.title: Calvary
films.cast: Brendan Gleeson, Chris O'Dowd, Kelly Reilly, Aidan Gillen
films.description: After being threatened during a confession, a good-natured priest must battle the dark forces closing in around him.

films.title: Bedazzled
films.cast: Brendan Fraser, Elizabeth Hurley, Frances O'Connor, Miriam Shor
films.description: Elliot Richardson, a suicidal techno geek, is given seven wishes to turn his life around when he meets a very seductive Satan. The catch: his soul. Some of his wishes include a 7 foot basketball star, a rock star, and a hamburger. But, as could be expected, the Devil puts her own little twist on each of his fantasies.

films.title: Lift
films.cast: Kevin Hart, Gugu Mbatha-Raw, Sam Worthington, Vincent D'Onofrio
films.description: An international heist crew, led by Cyrus Whitaker, race to lift $500 million in gold from a passenger plane at 40,000 feet.

films.title: Footloose
films.cast: Dennis Quaid, Kenny Wormald, Julianne Hough, Andie MacDowell
films.description: Ren MacCormack is transplanted from Boston to the small southern town of Bomont where loud music and dancing are prohibited. Not one to bow to the status quo, Ren challenges the ban, revitalizing the town and falling in love with the minister’s troubled daughter Ariel in the process.

films.title: Blinded by the Light
films.cast: Viveik Kalra, Nell Williams, Hayley Atwell, Kulvinder Ghir
films.description: In 1987, during the austere days of Thatcher’s Britain, a teenager learns to live life, understand his family, and find his own voice through the music of Bruce Springsteen.

films.title: Pain Hustlers
films.cast: Emily Blunt, Chris Evans, Catherine O'Hara, Jay Duplass
films.description: After losing her job, a single mom falls into a lucrative but ultimately dangerous scheme selling prescription drugs.

films.title: The Naked Gun 2½: The Smell of Fear
films.cast: Leslie Nielsen, Priscilla Presley, George Kennedy, O.J. Simpson
films.description: Bumbling lieutenant Frank Drebin is out to foil the big boys in the energy industry, who intend to suppress technology that will put them out of business.

films.title: House of Flying Daggers
films.cast: Takeshi Kaneshiro, Andy Lau, Zhang Ziyi, Song Dandan
films.description: In 9th century China, a corrupt government wages war against a rebel army called the Flying Daggers. A romantic warrior breaks a beautiful rebel out of prison to help her rejoin her fellows, but things are not what they seem.

films.title: Beneath the Planet of the Apes
films.cast: James Franciscus, Kim Hunter, Maurice Evans, Charlton Heston
films.description: The sole survivor of an interplanetary rescue mission lands on the planet of the apes, and uncovers a horrible secret beneath the surface.

films.title: Analyze This
films.cast: Robert De Niro, Billy Crystal, Lisa Kudrow, Chazz Palminteri
films.description: Countless wiseguy films are spoofed in this film that centers on the neuroses and angst of a powerful Mafia racketeer who suffers from panic attacks. When Paul Vitti needs help dealing with his role in the "family," unlucky shrink Dr. Ben Sobel is given just days to resolve Vitti's emotional crisis and turn him into a happy, well-adjusted gangster.

films.title: About Schmidt
films.cast: Jack Nicholson, Kathy Bates, Hope Davis, Dermot Mulroney
films.description: 66-year-old Warren Schmidt is a retired insurance salesman and has no particular plans other than to drive around in the motor home his wife insisted they buy. He's not altogether bitter, but not happy either, as everything his wife does annoys him, and he disapproves of the man his daughter is about to marry. When his wife suddenly dies, he sets out to postpone the imminent marriage of his…

films.title: Miss Congeniality 2: Armed and Fabulous
films.cast: Sandra Bullock, Regina King, Enrique Murciano, Ernie Hudson
films.description: After her triumph at the Miss United States pageant, FBI agent Gracie Hart becomes an overnight sensation -- and the new "face of the FBI". But it's time to spring into action again when the pageant's winner, Cheryl, and emcee, Stan, are abducted.

films.title: Trouble in Paradise
films.cast: Herbert Marshall, Kay Francis, Miriam Hopkins, Edward Everett Horton
films.description: Thief Gaston Monescu and pickpocket Lily are partners in crime and love. Working for perfume company executive Mariette Colet, the two crooks decide to combine their criminal talents to rob their employer. Under the alias of Monsieur Laval, Gaston uses his position as Mariette's personal secretary to become closer to her. However, he takes things too far when he actually falls in love with…

films.title: Blue Jean
films.cast: Rosy McEwen, Kerrie Hayes, Lucy Halliday, Lydia Page
films.description: Jean, a PE teacher, is forced to live a double life. When a new student arrives and threatens to expose her sexuality, Jean is pushed to extreme lengths to keep her job and her integrity.

films.title: Notes on a Scandal
films.cast: Judi Dench, Cate Blanchett, Bill Nighy, Andrew Simpson
films.description: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new "friend" also go well beyond platonic friendship.

films.title: The Grandmaster
films.cast: Tony Leung Chiu-wai, Zhang Ziyi, Chang Chen, Zhao Benshan
films.description: Ip Man's peaceful life in Foshan changes after Gong Yutian seeks an heir for his family in Southern China. Ip Man then meets Gong Er who challenges him for the sake of regaining her family's honor. After the Second Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man moves to Hong Kong and struggles to provide for his family. In the mean time, Gong Er chooses the path of vengeance after her father was killed by Ma San.

films.title: Smokey and the Bandit
films.cast: Burt Reynolds, Sally Field, Jerry Reed, Jackie Gleason
films.description: A race car driver tries to transport an illegal beer shipment from Texas to Atlanta in under 28 hours, picking up a reluctant bride-to-be on the way.

films.title: White Boy Rick
films.cast: Richie Merritt, Matthew McConaughey, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Bel Powley
films.description: The story of a teenager, Richard Wershe Jr., who became an undercover informant for the police during the 1980s and was ultimately arrested for drug-trafficking and sentenced to life in prison.

films.title: Far from the Madding Crowd
films.cast: Carey Mulligan, Matthias Schoenaerts, Michael Sheen, Tom Sturridge
films.description: Based on the literary classic by Thomas Hardy. Bathsheba Everdene, attracts three very different suitors: Gabriel Oak, a sheep farmer, captivated by her fetching willfulness; Frank Troy, a handsome and reckless Sergeant; and William Boldwood, a prosperous and mature bachelor. This timeless story of Bathsheba's choices and passions explores the nature of relationships and love – as well as the…

films.title: Summer of Sam
films.cast: John Leguizamo, Adrien Brody, Mira Sorvino, Jennifer Esposito
films.description: Spike Lee's take on the "Son of Sam" murders in New York City during the summer of 1977 centering on the residents of an Italian-American South Bronx neighborhood who live in fear and distrust of one another.

films.title: Happy-Go-Lucky
films.cast: Sally Hawkins, Eddie Marsan, Alexis Zegerman, Sylvestra Le Touzel
films.description: A look at a few chapters in the life of Poppy, a cheery, colorful, North London schoolteacher whose optimism tends to exasperate those around her.

films.title: August Rush
films.cast: Freddie Highmore, Keri Russell, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Terrence Howard
films.description: An orphaned musical prodigy uses his gift as a clue to finding his birth parents.

films.title: The Man from Toronto
films.cast: Kevin Hart, Woody Harrelson, Kaley Cuoco, Jasmine Mathews
films.description: In a case of mistaken identity, the world’s deadliest assassin, known as the Man from Toronto, and a New York City screw-up are forced to team up after being confused for each other at a rental cabin.

films.title: Red Riding Hood
films.cast: Amanda Seyfried, Gary Oldman, Billy Burke, Shiloh Fernandez
films.description: Valerie is in love with a brooding outsider, Peter, but her parents have arranged for her to marry another man – who is wealthy. Unwilling to lose each other, Valerie and Peter plan to run away together when they learn that Valerie's older sister has been killed by a werewolf that prowls the dark forest surrounding their village. Hungry for revenge, the people call on famed werewolf hunter,…

films.title: Dual
films.cast: Karen Gillan, Aaron Paul, Beulah Koale, Theo James
films.description: A terminally ill woman opts for a cloning procedure to ease her loss on her friends and family. When she makes a miraculous recovery, her attempts to have her clone decommissioned fail and lead to a court-mandated duel to the death.

films.title: Conquest of the Planet of the Apes
films.cast: Roddy McDowall, Don Murray, Ricardo Montalban, Hari Rhodes
films.description: In a futuristic world that has embraced ape slavery, a chimpanzee named Caesar resurfaces after almost twenty years of hiding from the authorities, and prepares for a revolt against humanity.

films.title: Spawn
films.cast: Michael Jai White, Martin Sheen, John Leguizamo, Theresa Randle
films.description: After being murdered by corrupt colleagues in a covert government agency, Al Simmons makes a pact with the devil to be resurrected to see his beloved wife Wanda. In exchange for his return to Earth, Simmons agrees to lead Hell's Army in the destruction of mankind.

films.title: The Bounty Hunter
films.cast: Gerard Butler, Jennifer Aniston, Peter Greene, Jeff Garlin
films.description: Milo Boyd is a bounty hunter whose latest gig is rather satisfying, as he finds out that the bail-skipper he must chase down is his own ex-wife, Nicole -- but she has no intention of getting nabbed without a fight. Complicating matters, Nicole's wannabe-boyfriend, Stewart, joins the chase.

films.title: Happy Hour
films.cast: Sachie Tanaka, Hazuki Kikuchi, Maiko Mihara, Rira Kawamura
films.description: Four women in their thirties reevaluate their relationships, both shared and private, after a startling revelation concerning one's marriage forces each of them to ask one of life's biggest questions: "Am I who I want to be?"

films.title: Summer 1993
films.cast: Laia Artigas, Paula Robles, Bruna Cusí, David Verdaguer
films.description: After her mother's death, six-year-old Frida is sent to her uncle's family to live with them in the countryside. But Frida finds it hard to forget her mother and adapt to her new life.

films.title: Gimme Shelter
films.cast: Mick Jagger, Charlie Watts, Keith Richards, Mick Taylor
films.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco.

films.title: 99 Homes
films.cast: Andrew Garfield, Michael Shannon, Laura Dern, Nicole Barré
films.description: After his family is evicted from their home, proud and desperate construction worker Dennis Nash tries to win his home back by striking a deal with the devil and working for Rick Carver, the corrupt real estate broker who evicted him.

films.title: Sputnik
films.cast: Oksana Akinshina, Pyotr Fyodorov, Fyodor Bondarchuk, Anton Vasilyev
films.description: At the height of the Cold War, a Soviet spacecraft crash lands after a mission gone awry, leaving the commander as its only survivor. After a renowned Russian psychologist is brought in to evaluate the commander’s mental state, it becomes clear that something dangerous may have come back to Earth with him…

films.title: Smokin' Aces
films.cast: Ryan Reynolds, Andy García, Martin Henderson, Chris Pine
films.description: When a Las Vegas performer-turned-snitch named Buddy Israel decides to turn state's evidence and testify against the mob, it seems that a whole lot of people would like to make sure he's no longer breathing.

films.title: Project Almanac
films.cast: Jonny Weston, Sofia Black-D'Elia, Sam Lerner, Allen Evangelista
films.description: A group of teens discover secret plans of a time machine, and construct one. However, things start to get out of control.

films.title: The Mole Agent
films.cast: Sergio Chamy, Rómulo Aitken, Marta Olivares, Berta Ureta
films.description: When a daughter becomes concerned about her mother’s well-being in a retirement home, private investigator Romulo hires Sergio, an 83 year-old man who becomes a new resident–and a mole inside the home, who struggles to balance his assignment with becoming increasingly involved in the lives of several residents.

films.title: Indecent Proposal
films.cast: Robert Redford, Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson, Seymour Cassel
films.description: John Gage offers a down-on-his-luck yuppie husband $1 million for the opportunity to spend the night with the man's wife.

films.title: Howards End
films.cast: Emma Thompson, Helena Bonham Carter, Anthony Hopkins, Samuel West
films.description: A saga of class relations and changing times in an Edwardian England on the brink of modernity, the film centers on liberal Margaret Schlegel, who, along with her sister Helen, becomes involved with two couples: wealthy, conservative industrialist Henry Wilcox and his wife Ruth, and the downwardly mobile working-class Leonard Bast and his mistress Jackie.

films.title: Push
films.cast: Chris Evans, Dakota Fanning, Camilla Belle, Djimon Hounsou
films.description: After his father, an assassin, is brutally murdered, Nick Gant vows revenge on Division, the covert government agency that dabbles in psychic warfare and experimental drugs. Hiding in Hong Kong's underworld, Nick assembles a band of rogue psychics dedicated to destroying Division. Together with Cassie, a teenage clairvoyant, Nick goes in search of a missing girl and a stolen suitcase that could…

films.title: Return to Never Land
films.cast: Harriet Owen, Blayne Weaver, Jeff Bennett, Kath Soucie
films.description: In 1940, the world is besieged by World War II. Wendy, all grown up, has two children; including Jane, who does not believe Wendy's stories about Peter Pan.

films.title: The Life of David Gale
films.cast: Kevin Spacey, Kate Winslet, Laura Linney, Rhona Mitra
films.description: A man against capital punishment is accused of murdering a fellow activist and is sent to death row.

films.title: Cat Person
films.cast: Emilia Jones, Nicholas Braun, Geraldine Viswanathan, Isabella Rossellini
films.description: When Margot, a college sophomore, goes on a date with the older Robert, she finds that IRL Robert doesn’t live up to the Robert she has been flirting with over texts.

films.title: Old Dads
films.cast: Bill Burr, Bobby Cannavale, Bokeem Woodbine, Katie Aselton
films.description: A cranky middle-aged dad and his two best friends find themselves out of step in a changing world of millennial CEOs and powerful preschool principals.

films.title: Wild Hogs
films.cast: Tim Allen, John Travolta, Martin Lawrence, William H. Macy
films.description: Restless and ready for an adventure, four suburban bikers leave the safety of their subdivision and head out on the open road. But complications ensue when they cross paths with an intimidating band of New Mexico bikers known as the Del Fuegos.

films.title: Before I Go to Sleep
films.cast: Nicole Kidman, Colin Firth, Mark Strong, Ben Crompton
films.description: A woman wakes up every day, remembering nothing as a result of a traumatic accident in her past. One day, new terrifying truths emerge that force her to question everyone around her.

films.title: The United States vs. Billie Holiday
films.cast: Andra Day, Trevante Rhodes, Garrett Hedlund, Leslie Jordan
films.description: Billie Holiday spent much of her career being adored by fans. In the 1940's, the government targeted Holiday in a growing effort to racialize the war on drugs, ultimately aiming to stop her from singing her controversial ballad, "Strange Fruit."

films.title: Star Trek: Generations
films.cast: Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton
films.description: Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise-D find themselves at odds with the renegade scientist Soran who is destroying entire star systems. Only one man can help Picard stop Soran's scheme...and he's been dead for seventy-eight years.

films.title: Louder Than Bombs
films.cast: Gabriel Byrne, Isabelle Huppert, Jesse Eisenberg, Devin Druid
films.description: Three years after his wife, acclaimed photographer Isabelle Reed, dies in a car crash, Gene keeps everyday life going with his shy teenage son, Conrad. A planned exhibition of Isabelle’s photographs prompts Gene's older son, Jonah, to return to the house he grew up in - and for the first time in a very long time, the father and the two brothers are living under the same roof.

films.title: Jersey Girl
films.cast: Ben Affleck, Raquel Castro, Liv Tyler, George Carlin
films.description: Ollie Trinke is a young, suave music publicist who seems to have it all, with a new wife and a baby on the way. But life deals him a bum hand when he's suddenly faced with single fatherhood, a defunct career and having to move in with his father. To bounce back, it takes a new love and the courage instilled in him by his daughter.

films.title: We Are Your Friends
films.cast: Zac Efron, Wes Bentley, Emily Ratajkowski, Jonny Weston
films.description: Young Cole Carter dreams of hitting the big time as a Hollywood disc jockey, spending his days and nights hanging with buddies and working on the one track that will set the world on fire. Opportunity comes knocking when he meets James Reed, a charismatic DJ who takes the 23-year-old under his wing. Soon, his seemingly clear path to success gets complicated when he starts falling for his mentor's…

films.title: No One Gets Out Alive
films.cast: Cristina Rodlo, Marc Menchaca, David Figlioli, Claudia Coulter
films.description: An immigrant in search of the American dream is forced to take a room in a boarding house and soon finds herself in a nightmare from which she can't escape.

films.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
films.cast: Alexandra Daddario, Tyler Hoechlin, Kimiko Glenn, Laverne Cox
films.description: Emma Corrigan, a girl with a few secrets on a turbulent plane ride, thinks she’s about to die, Emma spills them all to the handsome stranger sitting next to her. At least, she thought he was a stranger. But then, her company’s young and elusive CEO, arrives at the office. It’s him. And he knows every single humiliating detail about Emma.

films.title: Broken Arrow
films.cast: John Travolta, Christian Slater, Samantha Mathis, Delroy Lindo
films.description: When rogue stealth-fighter pilot Vic Deakins deliberately drops off the radar while on maneuvers, the Air Force ends up with two stolen nuclear warheads -- and Deakins's co-pilot, Riley Hale, is the military's only hope for getting them back. Traversing the deserted canyons of Utah, Hale teams with park ranger Terry Carmichael to put Deakins back in his box.

films.title: The One
films.cast: Jet Li, Carla Gugino, Delroy Lindo, Jason Statham
films.description: A sheriff's deputy fights an alternate universe version of himself who grows stronger with each alternate self he kills.

films.title: The Odd Couple
films.cast: Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, John Fiedler, Herb Edelman
films.description: In New York, Felix, a neurotic news writer who just broke up with his wife, is urged by his chaotic friend Oscar, a sports journalist, to move in with him, but their lifestyles are as different as night and day are, so Felix's ideas about housekeeping soon begin to irritate Oscar.

films.title: Where Eagles Dare
films.cast: Richard Burton, Clint Eastwood, Mary Ure, Patrick Wymark
films.description: World War II is raging, and an American general has been captured and is being held hostage in the Schloss Adler, a Bavarian castle that's nearly impossible to breach. It's up to a group of skilled Allied soldiers to liberate the general before it's too late.

films.title: Sleep
films.cast: Jung Yu-mi, Lee Sun-kyun, Kim Kuk-hee, Lee Kyung-jin
films.description: Hyun-su and Soo-jin are newlyweds. Seemingly out of nowhere, he starts talking in his sleep. “Someone’s inside.” From that night on, whenever he falls asleep, he transforms into someone else with no recollection of what happened the night before. Soo-jin is overwhelmed with anxiety that he’d hurt her family while she sleeps and can barely sleep a wink because of this irrational fear. Despite…

films.title: The Dry
films.cast: Eric Bana, Genevieve O'Reilly, Keir O'Donnell, John Polson
films.description: Aaron Falk returns to his drought-stricken hometown to attend a tragic funeral. But his return opens a decades-old wound - the unsolved death of a teenage girl.

films.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
films.cast: Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton
films.description: When an alien race and factions within Starfleet attempt to take over a planet that has "regenerative" properties, it falls upon Captain Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet's people as well as the very ideals upon which the Federation itself was founded.

films.title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
films.cast: Domhnall Gleeson, Will Tilston, Alex Lawther, Margot Robbie
films.description: The behind the scenes story of the life of A.A. Milne and the creation of the Winnie the Pooh stories inspired by his son Christopher Robin.

films.title: Flight of the Navigator
films.cast: Joey Cramer, Paul Reubens, Veronica Cartwright, Cliff DeYoung
films.description: 12-year-old David is accidentally knocked out in the forest near his home, but when he awakens eight years have passed. His family is overjoyed to have him back, but is just as perplexed as he is that he hasn't aged. When a NASA scientist discovers a UFO nearby, David gets the chance to unravel the mystery and recover the life he lost.

films.title: Red Dawn
films.cast: Chris Hemsworth, Josh Peck, Josh Hutcherson, Isabel Lucas
films.description: A city in Washington state awakens to the surreal sight of foreign paratroopers dropping from the sky—shockingly, the U.S. has been invaded and their hometown is the initial target. Quickly and without warning, the citizens find themselves prisoners and their town under enemy occupation. Determined to fight back, a group of young patriots seek refuge in the surrounding woods, training and…

films.title: Jonah Hex
films.cast: Josh Brolin, John Malkovich, Megan Fox, Michael Fassbender
films.description: Gunslinger Jonah Hex is appointed by President Ulysses Grant to track down terrorist Quentin Turnbull, a former Confederate officer determined on unleashing hell on earth. Jonah not only secures freedom by accepting this task, he also gets revenge on the man who slayed his wife and child.

films.title: Fatman
films.cast: Mel Gibson, Walton Goggins, Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Chance Hurstfield
films.description: A rowdy, unorthodox Santa Claus is fighting to save his declining business. Meanwhile, Billy, a neglected and precocious 12 year old, hires a hit man to kill Santa after receiving a lump of coal in his stocking.

films.title: Mother Joan of the Angels
films.cast: Lucyna Winnicka, Mieczysław Voit, Anna Ciepielewska, Maria Chwalibóg
films.description: A Polish priest arrives at a convent hoping to save the Mother Superior, who is supposedly possessed by eight demons.

films.title: Coming Home in the Dark
films.cast: Daniel Gillies, Erik Thomson, Miriama McDowell, Matthias Luafutu
films.description: A school teacher is forced to confront a brutal act from his past when a pair of ruthless drifters takes him and his family on a nightmare road-trip.

films.title: Romeo Must Die
films.cast: Jet Li, Aaliyah, Isaiah Washington, Russell Wong
films.description: Two warring gang families (one African-American, the other Chinese) maneuver for bragging rights to the Oakland, California, docks. Hang Sing and Trish O'Day uncover a trail of deceit that leaves most of the warring factions dead … or worse!

films.title: Made in U.S.A
films.cast: Anna Karina, László Szabó, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Marianne Faithfull
films.description: Paula Nelson goes to Atlantic City to meet her lover, Richard Politzer, but finds him  dead and decides to investigate his death. In her hotel room, she meets Typhus, whom she ends up knocking out. His corpse is later found in the apartment of David Goodis, a writer. Paula is arrested and interrogated. From then on, she encounters many gangsters.

films.title: VFW
films.cast: Stephen Lang, Martin Kove, William Sadler, David Patrick Kelly
films.description: A typical night for veterans at a VFW turns into an all-out battle for survival when a desperate teen runs into the bar with a bag of stolen drugs. When a gang of violent punks come looking for her, the vets use every weapon at their disposal to protect the girl and themselves from an unrelenting attack.

films.title: Incredible But True
films.cast: Alain Chabat, Léa Drucker, Anaïs Demoustier, Benoît Magimel
films.description: Alain and Marie moved to the suburb house of their dreams. But the real estate agent warned them: what is in the basement may well change their lives forever.

films.title: Repo Men
films.cast: Jude Law, Forest Whitaker, Alice Braga, Liev Schreiber
films.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims.

films.title: Arthur and the Revenge of Maltazard
films.cast: Freddie Highmore, Mia Farrow, Logan Miller, Robert Stanton
films.description: Arthur answers a distress call from Princess Selenia, who is menaced by the nefarious Maltazard.

films.title: A Boy Called Christmas
films.cast: Henry Lawfull, Michiel Huisman, Stephen Merchant, Maggie Smith
films.description: An ordinary young boy called Nikolas sets out on an extraordinary adventure into the snowy north in search of his father who is on a quest to discover the fabled village of the elves, Elfhelm. Taking with him a headstrong reindeer called Blitzen and a loyal pet mouse, Nikolas soon meets his destiny in this magical and endearing story that proves nothing is impossible…

films.title: The Captive
films.cast: Ryan Reynolds, Scott Speedman, Rosario Dawson, Mireille Enos
films.description: Eight years after the disappearance of Cassandra, some disturbing incidents seem to indicate that she's still alive. Police, parents and Cassandra herself, will try to unravel the mystery of her disappearance.

films.title: Project Wolf Hunting
films.cast: Seo In-guk, Jang Dong-yoon, Park Ho-san, Jeong So-min
films.description: While under heavily armed guard, the dangerous convicts aboard a cargo ship unite in a coordinated escape attempt that soon escalates into a bloody, all-out riot. But as the fugitives continue their brutal campaign of terror, they soon discover that not even the most vicious among them is safe from the horror they unknowingly unleashed from the darkness below deck.

films.title: Olaf's Frozen Adventure
films.cast: Josh Gad, Kristen Bell, Idina Menzel, Jonathan Groff
films.description: Olaf is on a mission to harness the best holiday traditions for Anna, Elsa, and Kristoff.

films.title: The Man with the Iron Fists
films.cast: RZA, Russell Crowe, Lucy Liu, Jamie Chung
films.description: In feudal China, a blacksmith who makes weapons for a small village is put in the position where he must defend himself and his fellow villagers.

films.title: From Paris with Love
films.cast: John Travolta, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Kasia Smutniak, Richard Durden
films.description: James Reese has a good job as an ambassador's aid in France, but his real passion is a side gig—working in a minor role in the CIA. He would love to be a full-fledged agent and can't believe his luck when he lands an assignment with Charlie Wax. Trigger-happy Charlie soon has James crying for his desk job, but when he learns that the same guys they're trying to catch are after him, James realises…

films.title: The Messenger: The Story of Joan of Arc
films.cast: Milla Jovovich, John Malkovich, Faye Dunaway, Dustin Hoffman
films.description: In 1429 a teenage girl from a remote French village stood before her King with a message she claimed came from God; that she would defeat the world's greatest army and liberate her country from its political and religious turmoil. Following her mission to reclaim god's diminished kingdom - through her amazing victories until her violent and untimely death.

films.title: Z-O-M-B-I-E-S 3
films.cast: Milo Manheim, Meg Donnelly, Chandler Kinney, Trevor Tordjman
films.description: Zed and Addison are beginning their final year at Seabrook High in the town that’s become a safe haven for monsters and humans alike. Zed is anticipating an athletic scholarship that will make him the first Zombie to attend college, while Addison is gearing up for Seabrook’s first international cheer-off competition. Then suddenly, extraterrestrial beings appear around Seabrook, provoking…

films.title: Billy Lynn's Long Halftime Walk
films.cast: Joe Alwyn, Kristen Stewart, Chris Tucker, Garrett Hedlund
films.description: 19-year-old Billy Lynn is brought home for a victory tour after a harrowing Iraq battle. Through flashbacks the film shows what really happened to his squad – contrasting the realities of war with America's perceptions.

films.title: The Guilt Trip
films.cast: Seth Rogen, Barbra Streisand, Yvonne Strahovski, Colin Hanks
films.description: An inventor and his mom hit the road together so he can sell his latest invention.

films.title: On Chesil Beach
films.cast: Saoirse Ronan, Billy Howle, Anne-Marie Duff, Adrian Scarborough
films.description: In 1962 England, a young couple finds their idyllic romance colliding with issues of sexual freedom and societal pressure, leading to an awkward and fateful wedding night.

films.title: Last Seen Alive
films.cast: Gerard Butler, Jaimie Alexander, Russell Hornsby, Ethan Embry
films.description: After Will Spann's wife suddenly vanishes at a gas station, his desperate search to find her leads him down a dark path that forces him to run from authorities and take the law into his own hands.

films.title: Queen of Hearts
films.cast: Trine Dyrholm, Gustav Lindh, Magnus Krepper, Liv Esmår Dannemann
films.description: Anne, a brilliant and dedicated advocacy lawyer specialising in society’s most vulnerable, children and young adults, lives what appears to be the picture-perfect life with her doctor-husband, Peter, and their twin daughters. When her estranged teenage stepson, Gustav, moves in with them, Anne’s escalating desire leads her down a dangerous rabbit hole which, once exposed, unleashes a sequence of…

films.title: The Prophecy
films.cast: Christopher Walken, Elias Koteas, Virginia Madsen, Eric Stoltz
films.description: The angel Gabriel comes to Earth to collect a soul which will end the stalemated war in Heaven, and only a former priest and a little girl can stop him.

films.title: Remember
films.cast: Christopher Plummer, Bruno Ganz, Jürgen Prochnow, Heinz Lieven
films.description: With the aid of a fellow Auschwitz survivor and a hand-written letter, an elderly man with dementia goes in search of the person responsible for the death of his family.

films.title: Planes: Fire & Rescue
films.cast: Ed Harris, Dane Cook, Julie Bowen, Curtis Armstrong
films.description: When world-famous air racer Dusty learns that his engine is damaged and he may never race again, he must shift gears and is launched into the world of aerial firefighting. Dusty joins forces with veteran fire and rescue helicopter Blade Ranger and his team, a bunch of all-terrain vehicles known as The Smokejumpers. Together, the fearless team battles a massive wildfire, and Dusty learns what it…

films.title: Kidnap
films.cast: Halle Berry, Sage Correa, Chris McGinn, Lew Temple
films.description: A mother (in her Minivan) stops at nothing to recover her kidnapped son.

films.title: La Cage aux Folles
films.cast: Ugo Tognazzi, Michel Serrault, Claire Maurier, Michel Galabru
films.description: Two gay men living in St. Tropez have their lives turned upside down when the son of one of the men announces he is getting married. They try to conceal their lifestyle and their ownership of the transvestite club downstairs when the fiancée and her parents come for dinner.

films.title: The Front Runner
films.cast: Hugh Jackman, Vera Farmiga, J.K. Simmons, Mark O'Brien
films.description: Gary Hart, former Senator of Colorado, becomes the front-runner for the Democratic presidential nomination in 1987. Hart's intelligence, charisma and idealism makes him popular with young voters, leaving him with a seemingly clear path to the White House. All that comes crashing down when allegations of an extramarital affair surface in the media, forcing the candidate to address a scandal that…

films.title: Land
films.cast: Robin Wright, Demián Bichir, Sarah Dawn Pledge, Kim Dickens
films.description: Edee, in the aftermath of an unfathomable event, finds herself unable to stay connected to the world she once knew and in the face of that uncertainty, retreats to the magnificent, but unforgiving, wilds of the Rockies. After a local hunter brings her back from the brink of death, she must find a way to live again.

films.title: Space Chimps
films.cast: Andy Samberg, Cheryl Hines, Jeff Daniels, Patrick Warburton
films.description: Three chimps are sent into space to explore the possibility of alien life when an unmanned space shuttle crash lands on an uncharted planet.

films.title: L'immensità
films.cast: Penélope Cruz, Vincenzo Amato, Luana Giuliani, Aurora Quattrocchi
films.description: Set in 1970s Rome, the fiction tracks the plight of a nuclear family, consisting of an unhappy married couple: Clara (a deeply dissatisfied expatriate Spaniard) and Felice (an abusive businessman cheating on Clara with his secretary) and their children Adriana, Gino, and Diana. Their eldest child, 12-year-old Adriana, experiences gender dysphoria; he rejects girlhood and instead goes by the name…

films.title: Call Jane
films.cast: Elizabeth Banks, Sigourney Weaver, Chris Messina, Wunmi Mosaku
films.description: A married woman with an unwanted pregnancy lives in a time in America where she can't get a legal abortion and works with a group of suburban women to find help.

films.title: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths Part One
films.cast: Matt Bomer, Jensen Ackles, Darren Criss, Meg Donnelly
films.description: Death is coming. Worse than death: oblivion. Not just for our Earth, but for everyone, everywhere, in every universe! Against this ultimate destruction, the mysterious Monitor has gathered the greatest team of Super Heroes ever assembled. But what can the combined might of Superman, Wonder Woman, Batman, The Flash, Green Lantern and hundreds of Super Heroes from multiple Earths even do to save…

films.title: Original Sin
films.cast: Angelina Jolie, Antonio Banderas, Thomas Jane, Gregory Itzin
films.description: A young man is plunged into a life of subterfuge, deceit and mistaken identity in pursuit of a femme fatale whose heart is never quite within his grasp

films.title: Follow Me
films.cast: Keegan Allen, Holland Roden, Denzel Whitaker, Ronen Rubinstein
films.description: A social media personality travels with his friends to Moscow to capture new content for his successful vlog. Always pushing the limits and catering to a growing audience, they enter a cold world of mystery, excess, and danger. When the lines between real life and social media are blurred, the group must fight to escape, and survive.

films.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
films.cast: Sylvester Stallone, Dave Bautista, Jesse Metcalfe, 50 Cent
films.description: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his most trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray must track him down with the help of some of his former friends.

films.title: A Little Chaos
films.cast: Kate Winslet, Matthias Schoenaerts, Alan Rickman, Stanley Tucci
films.description: A landscape gardener is hired by famous architect Le Nôtre to construct the grand gardens at the palace of Versailles. As the two work on the palace, they find themselves drawn to each other and are thrown into rivalries within the court of King Louis XIV.

films.title: Blitz
films.cast: Jason Statham, Paddy Considine, Aidan Gillen, Zawe Ashton
films.description: A tough cop is dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers.

films.title: Dear Comrades!
films.cast: Yuliya Vysotskaya, Vladislav Komarov, Andrei Gusev, Yulia Burova
films.description: When the communist government raises food prices in 1962, the rebellious workers from the small industrial town of Novocherkassk go on strike. The massacre which then ensues is seen through the eyes of a devout party activist.

films.title: The Twentieth Century
films.cast: Dan Beirne, Sarianne Cormier, Catherine St-Laurent, Mikhaïl Ahooja
films.description: Toronto, Canada, 1899. William Lyon Mackenzie King (1874-1950) fervently believes that he is destined to become Prime Minister, but to do so he will first have to fight his personal obsessions and overcome the many obstacles he will encounter on his tortuous path to power.

films.title: Demonic
films.cast: Carly Pope, Nathalie Boltt, Chris William Martin, Michael J Rogers
films.description: A young woman unleashes terrifying demons when supernatural forces at the root of a decades-old rift between mother and daughter are ruthlessly revealed.

films.title: The Milky Way
films.cast: Paul Frankeur, Laurent Terzieff, Alain Cuny, Édith Scob
films.description: Two men, part tramp, part pilgrim, are on their way to Santiago de Compostela in Spain. On their way they meet a whole assortment of people—some truculent, some violent, and some bizarre; they experience many adventures—some mysterious, some erotic, some even supernatural.

films.title: Far from Vietnam
films.cast: Maurice Garrel, Anne Bellec, Karen Blanguernon, Bernard Fresson
films.description: In seven different parts, Godard, Ivens, Klein, Lelouch, Marker, Resnais, and Varda show their sympathy for the North-Vietnamese army during the Vietnam War.

films.title: Hunt
films.cast: Lee Jung-jae, Jung Woo-sung, Jeon Hye-jin, Heo Sung-tae
films.description: After a high-ranking North Korean official requests asylum, KCIA Foreign Unit chief Park Pyong-ho and Domestic Unit chief Kim Jung-do are tasked with uncovering a North Korean spy, known as Donglim, who is deeply embedded within their agency. When the spy begins leaking top secret intel that could jeopardize national security, the two units are each assigned to investigate each other.

films.title: In the Aisles
films.cast: Franz Rogowski, Sandra Hüller, Peter Kurth, Henning Peker
films.description: Christian, a reclusive young man from Leipzig, gets a job working the night shift at a big-box store. He's trained to stocks goods and operate a forklift by Bruno, a wistful former truck driver, who introduces Christian to a colorful group of overnight workers, including Marion, with whom Christian develops a troubled infatuation.

films.title: Cradle 2 the Grave
films.cast: Jet Li, DMX, Kelly Hu, Anthony Anderson
films.description: Gang leader Tony pulls off a major diamond heist with his crew, but cop-turned-criminal Ling knows who has the loot and responds by kidnapping Tony's daughter and holding her for ransom. Unfortunately, Tony's lost the diamonds as well. As he frantically searches for his daughter and the jewels, Tony pairs with a high-kicking government agent who once worked with Ling and seeks revenge on him.

films.title: Night of the Kings
films.cast: Koné Bakary, Steve Tientcheu, Digbeu Jean Cyrille, Rasmané Ouédraogo
films.description: A young man is sent to "La Maca," a prison in the middle of the Ivorian forest ruled by its inmates. As tradition goes with the rising of the red moon, he is designated by the Boss to be the new "Roman" and must tell a story to the other prisoners. Learning what fate awaits him, he begins to narrate the mystical life of the legendary outlaw named "Zama King" and has no choice but to make his…

films.title: She Will
films.cast: Alice Krige, Kota Eberhardt, Malcolm McDowell, Rupert Everett
films.description: Veronica, an aging film star, retreats to the Scottish countryside with her nurse Desi to recover from  a double mastectomy. While there, mysterious forces give Veronica the power to enact revenge within her dreams.

films.title: Code 8 Part II
films.cast: Robbie Amell, Stephen Amell, Alex Mallari Jr., Sirena Gulamgaus
films.description: In a world where superpowered people are heavily policed by robots, an ex-con teams up with a drug lord he despises to protect a teen from a corrupt cop.

films.title: Sieranevada
films.cast: Mimi Brănescu, Eugenia Bosânceanu, Marian Rîlea, Rolando Matsangos
films.description: Back from a professional trip to Paris, a neurologist at the pinnacle of his career has to pick up his wife so that they can attend a family meal to commemorate his father, who died a year before. At his mother's flat, the guests are waiting for the priest to arrive while arguing about all kinds of things connected and unconnected with the world’s events and wars.

films.title: Forever Young
films.cast: Mel Gibson, Jamie Lee Curtis, Elijah Wood, Isabel Glasser
films.description: A 1939 test pilot asks his best friend to use him as a guinea pig for a cryogenics experiment. Daniel McCormick wants to be frozen for a year so that he doesn't have to watch his love lying in a coma. The next thing Daniel knows is that he's been awoken in 1992.

films.title: The Sicilian Clan
films.cast: Jean Gabin, Alain Delon, Lino Ventura, Irina Demick
films.description: An ambitious mobster plans an elaborate diamond heist while seducing the daughter-in-law of a ruthless mob patriarch as a determined police commissioner closes in on all of them.

films.title: Escape from Planet Earth
films.cast: Rob Corddry, Brendan Fraser, Jessica Alba, Steve Zahn
films.description: Astronaut Scorch Supernova finds himself caught in a trap when he responds to an SOS from a notoriously dangerous alien planet.

films.title: The Rebound
films.cast: Catherine Zeta-Jones, Justin Bartha, Art Garfunkel, Joanna Gleason
films.description: Upon discovering her husband's infidelity, Sandy leaves the suburbs and moves into the city. There, she befriends Aram, a guy whose wife only married him so she could get a green card. Sandy hires Aram to be her nanny, and  it isn't long until Aram and Sandy find out they get along wonderfully and start to date. But is their relationship real or is it, in fact, just a rebound for both of them?

films.title: Perfect Stranger
films.cast: Halle Berry, Bruce Willis, Giovanni Ribisi, Richard Portnow
films.description: A journalist goes undercover to ferret out businessman Harrison Hill as her best friend's killer. Posing as one of his temps, she enters into a game of online cat-and-mouse.

films.title: Bait
films.cast: Sharni Vinson, Phoebe Tonkin, Julian McMahon, Alex Russell
films.description: A freak tsunami traps shoppers at a coastal Australian supermarket inside the building ... along with a 12-foot great white shark.

films.title: 2 Days in New York
films.cast: Julie Delpy, Chris Rock, Albert Delpy, Kate Burton
films.description: Marion and Mingus both come from failed relationships but, by bringing their children together, they've managed to form a small yet happy family. Tensions in their household soon begin to spike when Marion's jovial father shows up on their doorstep with his randy daughter and her peculiar boyfriend in tow. As the motor-mouthed houseguests shatter every taboo imaginable, the happy couple begin to…

films.title: The Dive
films.cast: Louisa Krause, Sophie Lowe, Stella Uhrig, Shire Richardson
films.description: Two sisters go diving at a beautiful, remote location. One of the sisters is struck by a rock, leaving her trapped 28 meters below. With dangerously low levels of oxygen and cold temperatures, it is up to her sister to fight for her life.

films.title: Big Game
films.cast: Samuel L. Jackson, Onni Tommila, Ray Stevenson, Victor Garber
films.description: Air Force One is shot down by terrorists, leaving the President of the United States stranded in the wilderness of Finland. 13-year-old Oskari is on a hunting mission to prove his maturity to his kinsfolk by tracking down a deer, but instead discovers the President in an escape pod. With the terrorists closing in to capture their prize, the unlikely duo team up to escape their hunters.

films.title: Police Academy 5: Assignment Miami Beach
films.cast: Bubba Smith, David Graf, Michael Winslow, Leslie Easterbrook
films.description: The Police Academy misfits travel to Miami Beach for Commandant Lassard to be honored with a prestigious lifetime award pending his retirement. Things take a turn when Lassard unknowingly ends up in possession of stolen diamonds from a jewel heist.

films.title: The Stranger
films.cast: Marcello Mastroianni, Anna Karina, Bernard Blier, Alfred Adam
films.description: Meursault is a man who feels utterly isolated from everyone and everything around him. This alienation results in sudden, inexplicable bursts of violence, culminating in murder.

films.title: Blood Machines
films.cast: Elisa Lasowski, Anders Heinrichsen, Christian Erickson, Natasha Cashman
films.description: An artificial intelligence escapes her spaceship to turn into a female ghost and challenges two blade runners to a galactic chase.

films.title: Great White
films.cast: Katrina Bowden, Te Kohe Tuhaka, Aaron Jakubenko, Kimie Tsukakoshi
films.description: A sea plane is destroyed in a freak accident, five people find themselves drifting on a raft. At the mercy of the tide and with no hope of rescue, the helpless situation takes a horrifying turn when they are terrorized by a ravenous great white.

films.title: Man of Marble
films.cast: Krystyna Janda, Jerzy Radziwiłowicz, Tadeusz Łomnicki, Jacek Lomnicki
films.description: A young Polish filmmaker sets out to find out what happened to Mateusz Birkut, a bricklayer who became a propaganda hero in the 1950s but later fell out of favor and disappeared.

films.title: Rojo
films.cast: Darío Grandinetti, Andrea Frigerio, Alfredo Castro, Laura Grandinetti
films.description: A small town in an Argentinian province, 1975. The life of Claudio, a successful lawyer, gets complicated when he has a stupid quarrel with a stranger in a crowded restaurant.

films.title: Ordinary Angels
films.cast: Hilary Swank, Alan Ritchson, Emily Mitchell, Skywalker Hughes
films.description: In Louisville, Kentucky, hairdresser Sharon Stevens rallies the masses to help widowed father Ed Schmitt save his critically ill 5 year old daughter Michelle after their community is hit by a major snowstorm from the 1994 North American cold wave.

films.title: The Keeper of Lost Causes
films.cast: Nikolaj Lie Kaas, Fares Fares, Sonja Richter, Mikkel Boe Følsgaard
films.description: Denmark, 2013. Police officers Carl Mørck and Hafez el-Assad, sole members of Department Q, which is focused on closing cold cases, investigate the disappearance of politician Merete Lynggaard, vanished when she and her brother were traveling aboard a ferry five years ago.

films.title: Pink
films.cast: Amitabh Bachchan, Taapsee Pannu, Kirti Kulhari, Andrea Tariang
films.description: A sexual assault victim, unjustly tried for the attempted murder of her attacker, is defended by a retired lawyer who challenges India's rape culture.

films.title: Hangmen Also Die!
films.cast: Brian Donlevy, Walter Brennan, Anna Lee, Gene Lockhart
films.description: During the Nazi occupation of Czechoslovakia, surgeon Dr. Franticek Svoboda, a Czech patriot, assassinates the brutal "Hangman of Europe", Reichsprotektor Reinhard Heydrich, and is wounded in the process. In his attempt to escape, he is helped by history professor Stephen Novotny and his daughter Mascha.

films.title: Dom Hemingway
films.cast: Jude Law, Demián Bichir, Richard E. Grant, Matthew C. Martino
films.description: After spending 12 years in prison for keeping his mouth shut, notorious safe-cracker Dom Hemingway is back on the streets of London looking to collect what he's owed.

films.title: Bad Company
films.cast: Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Gabriel Macht, Peter Stormare
films.description: When a Harvard-educated CIA agent is killed during an operation, the secret agency recruits his twin brother.

films.title: The Lift
films.cast: Huub Stapel, Willeke van Ammelrooy, Josine van Dalsum, Liz Snoyink
films.description: A lift technician finds himself drawn into a web of mystery and peril as he investigates the perplexing deadly accidents occurring in the elevators of a new office building.

films.title: Rodeo
films.cast: Julie Ledru, Antonia Buresi, Yanis Lafki, Louis Sotton
films.description: Hot-tempered and fiercely independent gearhead Julia, meets a crew of dirt riders who fly along at full speed and perform stunts. She sets about infiltrating their male-dominated world, until an accident jeopardizes her ability to fit in.

films.title: The Collini Case
films.cast: Elyas M'Barek, Heiner Lauterbach, Alexandra Maria Lara, Jannis Niewöhner
films.description: A young lawyer stumbles upon a vast conspiracy while investigating a brutal murder case.

films.title: Buñuel in the Labyrinth of the Turtles
films.cast: Jorge Usón, Fernando Ramos, Luis Enrique de Tomás, Cyril Corral
films.description: Paris, 1930. Luis Buñuel is penniless after the scandal surrounding the release of his last movie. Sculptor Ramón Acín, a good friend, buys a lottery ticket and promises Buñuel that he will pay for his next movie if he wins the prize.

films.title: A Real Young Girl
films.cast: Charlotte Alexandra, Hiram Keller, Rita Maiden, Bruno Balp
films.description: Bored and restless, Alice spends much of her time lusting after Jim, a local sawmill worker. When not lusting after him, Alice fills the hours with such pursuits as writing her name on a mirror with vaginal secretions and wandering the fields with her underwear around her ankles. And, in true teenaged tradition, she spends a lot of time writing in her diary.

films.title: Serial (Bad) Weddings 2
films.cast: Christian Clavier, Chantal Lauby, Ary Abittan, Medi Sadoun
films.description: Claude and Marie Verneuil face a new crisis. The four spouses of their daughters, David, Rachid, Chao and Charles decided to leave France for various reasons. Here they are imagining their lives elsewhere.

films.title: Viking Wolf
films.cast: Elli Rhiannon Müller Osborne, Liv Mjönes, Vidar Magnussen, Mia Fosshaug Laubacher
films.description: After witnessing a grotesque murder at a party in her new town, a teenager starts having strange visions and bizarre desires.

films.title: A Man Apart
films.cast: Vin Diesel, Larenz Tate, Timothy Olyphant, Geno Silva
films.description: When Vetter's wife is killed in a botched hit organized by Diablo, he seeks revenge against those responsible. But in the process, Vetter and Hicks have to fight their way up the chain to get to Diablo but it's easier said than done when all Vetter can focus on is revenge.

films.title: One Deadly Summer
films.cast: Isabelle Adjani, Alain Souchon, Suzanne Flon, Jenny Clève
films.description: In spring 1976, a 19-year-old beauty, her German-born mother, and her crippled father move to the town of a firefighter nicknamed Pin-Pon. Everyone notices the provocative Eliane. She singles out Pin-Pon and soon is crying on his shoulder (she's myopic and hates her reputation as a dunce and as easy); she moves in with him, knits baby clothes, and plans their wedding. Is this love or some kind of…

films.title: Cesar and Rosalie
films.cast: Romy Schneider, Yves Montand, Sami Frey, Umberto Orsini
films.description: Rosalie, a beautiful young woman gets involved with successful businessman Cesar. One day, Rosalie's former flame David appears and attempts to win her back. Cesar reacts with a jealous intensity never before seen by Rosalie, and because of that, she returns to David. She remains conflicted regarding her choice of partner, but eventually, one of the men does something which resolves the situation.

films.title: SUGA: Road to D-DAY
films.cast: Min Yoon-gi, Halsey, Steve Aoki, Anderson .Paak
films.description: SUGA of the world-renowned group, BTS, works on a new album. He embarks on a journey to find his story to tell through music, while interacting with artists from various cities around the world.

films.title: Ashfall
films.cast: Lee Byung-hun, Ha Jung-woo, Ma Dong-seok, Jeon Hye-jin
films.description: A group of unlikely heroes from across the Korean peninsula try to save the day after a volcano erupts on the mythical and majestic Baekdu Mountain.

films.title: Delicious
films.cast: Isabelle Carré, Grégory Gadebois, Benjamin Lavernhe, Guillaume de Tonquédec
films.description: France, 1789 - just before the Revolution. When talented chef Manceron is dismissed from his prestigious position by the Duke of Chamfort, he loses the taste for cooking. But when he meets the mysterious Louise, together they decide to create the very first restaurant in France.

films.title: Do Not Disturb
films.cast: Cem Yılmaz, Ahsen Eroğlu, Celal Kadri Kınoğlu, Özge Özberk
films.description: A middle-aged man emerges from a pandemic slump with a new job at a quiet hotel, until some eccentric guests turn his first night into a wild adventure.

films.title: Blackbird Blackbird Blackberry
films.cast: Eka Chavleishvili, Temiko Chichinadze, Piqria Niqabadze, Tamar Mdinaradze
films.description: In a small traditional Georgian village, Etero, the owner of a housekeeping shop, is a forty-eight-year-old spinster. She cherishes her freedom, as much as her cakes, and is preparing for a peaceful and comfortable retirement away from gossip. But a fiery affair with her delivery man could derail all her plans.

films.title: Hope Gap
films.cast: Annette Bening, Bill Nighy, Josh O'Connor, Aiysha Hart
films.description: Grace lives an idyllic life in a British seaside town, but her world soon comes crashing down when her husband of 29 years tells her he's leaving her for another woman. Through stages of shock, disbelief and anger -- and with support from her son -- Grace ultimately regains her footing while learning it's never too late to be happy.

films.title: Cold Case Hammarskjöld
films.cast: Mads Brügger, Clarinah Mfengu, Saphir Wenzi Mabanza, Göran Björkdahl
films.description: Ndola, Northern Rhodesia (currently Zambia), September 18th, 1961. Swedish Dag Hammarskjöld, UN Secretary-General, mysteriously dies in a plane crash. Decades later, Danish journalist and filmmaker Mads Brügger and Swedish researcher Göran Björkdahl investigate the case looking for a definitive closure.

films.title: The Visitors II: The Corridors of Time
films.cast: Christian Clavier, Jean Reno, Muriel Robin, Marie-Anne Chazel
films.description: The sequel to The Visitors reunites us with those lovable ruffians from the French Medieval ages who - through magic - are transported into the present, with often drastic consequences. Godefroy de Montmirail travels to today to recover the missing family jewels and a sacred relic, guarantor of his wife-to-be's fertility. The confrontation between Godefroy's repellent servant Jack the Crack and…

films.title: The Possession of Michael King
films.cast: Shane Johnson, Ella Anderson, Cara Pifko, Julie McNiven
films.description: The film tells the story of documentary filmmaker Michael King (Shane Johnson), who doesn’t believe in God or the Devil. Following the sudden death of his wife, Michael decides to make his next film about the search for the existence of the supernatural, making himself the center of the experiment – allowing demonologists, necromancers, and various practitioners of the occult to try the deepest…

films.title: Playing for Keeps
films.cast: Gerard Butler, Jessica Biel, Uma Thurman, Catherine Zeta-Jones
films.description: A former sports star who's fallen on hard times starts coaching his son's soccer team in an attempt to get his life together.

films.title: Tad, the Lost Explorer
films.cast: Óscar Barberán, Michelle Jenner, José Mota, Pep Anton Muñoz
films.description: Tad is a celebrity archaeologist and adventurer just like his hero Max Mordon... in his dreams! In reality, Tad is a Chicago construction worker. One day, however, he is mistaken for a real professor and takes his place on a flight to Peru in search of the lost city of Paititi.

films.title: Consenting Adults
films.cast: Kevin Kline, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Kevin Spacey, Rebecca Miller
films.description: Richard and Priscilla Parker are an ordinary suburban couple whose lives are invaded and rocked by their hedonistic, secretive new neighbors, Eddy and Kay Otis.

films.title: Palm Trees in the Snow
films.cast: Mario Casas, Adriana Ugarte, Macarena García, Alain Hernández
films.description: Spain, 2003. An accidental discovery leads Clarence to travel from the snowy mountains of Huesca to Equatorial Guinea, to visit the land where her father Jacobo and her uncle Kilian spent most of their youth, the island of Fernando Poo.

films.title: Long Story Short
films.cast: Rafe Spall, Zahra Newman, Ronny Chieng, Dena Kaplan
films.description: Teddy wakes up the morning after his wedding to discover that he's jumped forward a year in his life to his first anniversary. Trapped in an endless cycle of time jumps, transported another year ahead every few minutes, he is faced with a race against time as his life crumbles around him.

films.title: At the End of the Tunnel
films.cast: Leonardo Sbaraglia, Pablo Echarri, Clara Lago, Federico Luppi
films.description: A paraplegic computer engineer that moves in a wheelchair and works in his basement starts hearing noises and voices of bank-robbers.

films.title: Easy Money
films.cast: Joel Kinnaman, Matias Varela, Dragomir Mrsic, Lisa Henni
films.description: When JW becomes a drug runner in order to maintain his double life, his fate becomes tied to two other men: Jorge, a fugitive on the run from both the Serbian mafia and the police, and mafia enforcer Mrado, who is on the hunt for Jorge.

films.title: Tracers
films.cast: Taylor Lautner, Marie Avgeropoulos, Adam Rayner, Rafi Gavron
films.description: Wanted by the mafia, a New York City bike messenger escapes into the world of parkour after meeting a beautiful stranger.

films.title: Ernest & Celestine: A Trip to Gibberitia
films.cast: Lambert Wilson, Pauline Brunner, Michel Lerousseau, Céline Ronté
films.description: Ernest and Celestine are travelling back to Ernest's country, Gibberitia, to fix his broken violin. This exotic land is home to the best musicians on earth and music constantly fills the air with joy. However, upon arriving, our two heroes discover that all forms of music have been banned for many years - and for them, a life without music is unthinkable. Along with their friends and a mysterious…

films.title: The Patience Stone
films.cast: Golshifteh Farahani, Hamid Djavadan, Hassina Burgan, Massi Mrowat
films.description: In a war-ridden country, a woman watches over her husband, comatose from a bullet in the neck and abandoned by Jihad companions and brothers. One day, the woman decides to say things to him she could never have done before.

films.title: Swimming Out Till the Sea Turns Blue
films.cast: Huifang Duan, Liang Hong, Pingwa Jia, Yu Hua
films.description: Filmmaker Jia Zhangke chronicles his local literature festival in Shanxi, China which includes a multi-generational roster of the country's most esteemed writers.

films.title: The Student
films.cast: Sophie Marceau, Vincent Lindon, Élisabeth Vitali, Jean-Claude Leguay
films.description: An ambitious teaching student's finals studies are interrupted by a passionate affair with a jazz musician.

films.title: The Temptation of St. Tony
films.cast: Taavi Eelmaa, Ravshana Kurkova, Tiina Tauraite, Sten Ljunggren
films.description: A mid-level manager who develops an aversion to being a good person questions his morality as he faces the challenges of middle age and loses control of his life.

films.title: Come Away
films.cast: Angelina Jolie, Jordan A. Nash, Keira Chansa, Michael Caine
films.description: Before Alice went to Wonderland, and before Peter became Pan, they were brother and sister. When their eldest brother dies in a tragic accident, they each seek to save their parents from their downward spirals of despair until finally they are forced to choose between home and imagination, setting the stage for their iconic journeys into Wonderland and Neverland.

films.title: White Mane
films.cast: Alain Emery, Laurent Roche, Pascal Lamorisse, Denys Colomb de Daunant
films.description: In the south of France, in a vast plain region called the Camargue, lives White Mane, a magnificent stallion and the leader of a herd of wild horses too proud to let themselves be broken by humans. Only Folco, a young fisherman, manages to tame him. A strong friendship grows between the boy and the horse, as the two go looking for the freedom that the world of men won’t allow them.

films.title: Funan
films.cast: Bérénice Bejo, Louis Garrel, Colette Kieffer, Aude-Laurence Clermont Biver
films.description: Cambodia, once the ancient kingdom of Funan, April 17th, 1975. The entire country falls under the tyranny of Angkar, the communist party of the Khmer Rouge. The cities are abandoned, the population is thrown to the roads and forced to walk towards an uncertain future…

films.title: Lucifer
films.cast: Mohanlal, Vivek Oberoi, Manju Warrier, Tovino Thomas
films.description: In God's own country, the supreme leader of the ruling party dies, leaving a huge vacuum, not only in the electoral and leadership sphere of the party but also that of the state. In the inevitable succession squabble and the power struggle that ensues, the thin line that separates good and bad becomes irrecoverably blurred and out of this seemingly endless mayhem, emerge forces that are hitherto…

films.title: EVA
films.cast: Daniel Brühl, Marta Etura, Alberto Ammann, Claudia Vega
films.description: In 2041, humans live side-by-side with robots and androids. A well-known cybernetic engineer, Alex Garel, returns to his hometown to create a new model of robot child.

films.title: Chéri
films.cast: Michelle Pfeiffer, Kathy Bates, Rupert Friend, Felicity Jones
films.description: The son of a courtesan retreats into a fantasy world after being forced to end his relationship with the older woman who educated him in the ways of love.

films.title: The Secrets We Keep
films.cast: Noomi Rapace, Joel Kinnaman, Chris Messina, Amy Seimetz
films.description: In post-World War II America, a woman, rebuilding her life in the suburbs with her husband, kidnaps her neighbor and seeks vengeance for the heinous war crimes she believes he committed against her.

films.title: Delphine and Carole
films.cast: Delphine Seyrig, Carole Roussopoulos, Alexandra Roussopoulos, Chantal Akerman
films.description: In the 70s, actress Delphine Seyrig and director Carole Roussopoulos, both militant feminists, were the pioneers of video activism in France. They documented the demonstrations of French feminists and used the new technologies to counter the poor representation of women in the public media.

films.title: The Eyes of Orson Welles
films.cast: Jack Klaff, Mark Cousins, Beatrice Welles, Orson Welles
films.description: A poetic journey into the visual world of the legendary filmmaker and actor Orson Welles (1915-85) that reveals a new portrait of a unique genius, both of his life and of his monumental work: through his own eyes, drawn by his own hand, painted with his own brush.

films.title: Copa 71
films.cast: Brandi Chastain, Nicole Mangas, Silvia Zaragoza, Alex Morgan
films.description: The extraordinary story of the 1971 Women’s World Cup, which was held in Mexico City and witnessed by more than 100,000 fans. This landmark tournament was dismissed by FIFA and written out of sports history – until now. COPA 71 weaves together dazzling archival footage and interviews with the former players.

films.title: The Virtuoso
films.cast: Anthony Hopkins, Anson Mount, Abbie Cornish, Diora Baird
films.description: Danger, deception and murder descend upon a sleepy town when a professional assassin accepts a new assignment from his enigmatic boss.

films.title: The Awakening of Motti Wolkenbruch
films.cast: Noémie Schmidt, Joel Basman, Sunnyi Melles, Udo Samel
films.description: The young Orthodox Jew, Motti Wolkenbruch, finds himself at a turning point. His beloved mother wants him to get married and presents one marriage candidate after the other. Unfortunately none of the woman pleases him, because they all look just like her. The situation gets even more complicated, when Motti secretly falls in love with the non-Jewish girl Laura, a so-called Shiksa.

films.title: La Marseillaise
films.cast: Pierre Renoir, Lise Delamare, Louis Jouvet, Jaque Catelain
films.description: A film about the early part of the French Revolution, shown from the eyes of the citizens of Marseille, counts in German exile and, of course, the king Louis XVI, each showing their own small problems.

films.title: 6ixtynin9
films.cast: Lalita Panyopas, Black Phomtong, Arun Wannarbodeewong, Tasanawalai Ongartittichai
films.description: A woman, fired from a financial corporation during the Asia crisis, returns home with no money. However, she finds a box with a fortune in front of her door, and decides to keep it. However, the people that left it there soon want it back.

films.title: He Even Has Your Eyes
films.cast: Lucien Jean-Baptiste, Aïssa Maïga, Zabou Breitman, Vincent Elbaz
films.description: Paul is married to Sali. Everything would be fine if they could get a child. Until the day when Sali receives the call that they have been waiting for so long: their adoption file is approved. He is adorable, he is 6 months old, his name is Benjamin. He is blond with blue eyes and white. They - are black.

films.title: Tad, the Lost Explorer, and the Secret of King Midas
films.director: Enrique Gato, David Alonso Pérez de Algaba
films.cast: Óscar Barberán, Michelle Jenner, Adriana Ugarte, Luis Posada
films.description: Tad dreams of becoming an archaeologist traveling the world, uncovering hidden secrets and lost treasure, but his job working construction keeps him daydreaming instead of exploring. The chance of a lifetime comes when he is invited to attend archaeologist Sara Lavrof's presentation of her latest discovery - the papyrus that proves the existence of the Necklace of Midas, the legendary King who…

films.title: Six Minutes to Midnight
films.cast: Eddie Izzard, Carla Juri, James D'Arcy, Celyn Jones
films.description: Summer 1939. Influential families in Nazi Germany have sent their daughters to a finishing school in an English seaside town to learn the language and be ambassadors for a future looking National Socialist. A teacher there sees what is coming and is trying to raise the alarm. But the authorities believe he is the problem.

films.title: Extremities
films.cast: Farrah Fawcett, James Russo, Alfre Woodard, Diana Scarwid
films.description: A woman escapes from the man who is about to rape her, but leaves her purse behind. Afraid that her attacker might come after her, she goes to the police, but with no proof of the incident, they can do nothing. In fact, the man does use the information in her bag and comes to her apartment with the intent of rape, but she sprays him in the face with insect repellent, and then holds him captive.…

films.title: Mrs. Fang
films.cast: Fang Xiuying
films.description: In a quiet village in southern China, Fang Xiuying is sixty-seven years old. Having suffered from Alzheimer's for several years, with advanced symptoms and ineffective treatment, she was sent back home. Now, bedridden, she is surrounded by her relatives and neighbors, as they witness and accompany her through her last days.

films.title: Simple Passion
films.cast: Laetitia Dosch, Sergei Polunin, Lou-Teymour Thion, Caroline Ducey
films.description: A man and a woman are brought together by chance for several months. He is younger than she is, married, Russian, officially a diplomat stationed in Paris. She is a beautiful teacher and researcher, with her feet firmly on the ground. The film follows the evolution of their love, from the beginning to end.

films.title: Into the West
films.cast: Gabriel Byrne, Ellen Barkin, Ciarán Fitzgerald, Rúaidhrí Conroy
films.description: Accused of a crime they didn't commit, two city kids and a magical horse are about to become the coolest outlaws ever to ride Into The West.

films.title: Reflection
films.cast: Roman Lutskyi, Andrii Rymaruk, Nika Myslytska, Nadiia Levchenko
films.description: The film centers on Ukrainian surgeon Serhiy, who is captured by the Russian military forces in the conflict zone in Eastern Ukraine, and while in captivity, he is exposed to horrifying scenes of humiliation, violence and indifference toward human life. After his release, he returns to his comfortable middle-class apartment and tries to find a purpose in life by rebuilding his relationship with…

films.title: Angry Indian Goddesses
films.cast: Sarah-Jane Dias, Rajshri Deshpande, Sandhya Mridul, Amy Maghera
films.description: A photographer invites her closest friends to vacation at her family's home in Goa in celebration of her upcoming marriage.

films.title: I Served the King of England
films.cast: Ivan Barnev, Oldřich Kaiser, Julia Jentsch, Marián Labuda
films.description: Prague, Czechoslovakia, during the inter-war period. Jan Dítě, a young and clever waiter who wants to become a millionaire, comes to the conclusion that to achieve his ambitious goal he must be diligent, listen and observe as much as he can, be always discreet and use what he learns to his own advantage; but the turbulent tides of history will continually stand in his way.

films.title: In Her Name
films.cast: Daniel Auteuil, Sebastian Koch, Marie-Josée Croze, Christelle Cornil
films.description: In 1982, André Bamberski learns about the death of his 14 year-old daughter, Kalinka, while she was on vacation with her mother and stepfather in Germany. Convinced that Kalinka’s death was not an accident, Bamberski begins to investigate. A botched autopsy report raises his suspicions and leads him to accuse Kalinka’s stepfather, Dr Dieter Krombach, as the murderer. Unable to indict Krombach in…

films.title: Skirt Day
films.cast: Isabelle Adjani, Denis Podalydès, Jackie Berroyer, Yann Collette
films.description: A teacher, driven to exasperation from insults and insubordination, takes her class hostage.

films.title: The Twins Effect
films.cast: Gillian Chung, Charlene Choi, Ekin Cheng Yee-Kin, Josie Ho
films.description: An evil Duke attempts to kill and collect the blood of a royal family of European vampires in order to become all powerful. The only surviving member of the family travels to Hong Kong, only to complicate his struggle by falling in love with a mortal girl who just happens to have a vampire hunter for a brother.

films.title: The Sense of Wonder
films.cast: Virginie Efira, Benjamin Lavernhe, Lucie Fagedet, Léo Lorléac'h
films.description: Louise, a widow with two children, almost crushes a stranger with her car. She takes care of him, even if he's not really wounded. It turns out that he has mental disorders and that they can help each other much more than they thought.

films.title: The Well Digger's Daughter
films.cast: Daniel Auteuil, Astrid Bergès-Frisbey, Kad Merad, Sabine Azéma
films.description: It's the beginning of the WWII. South of France. Patricia, 18, is the oldest daughter of a well-digger, Pascal, who considers her a princess because of her moral qualities. She's kind, devoted. One day, she briefly meets a young man, Jacques, the son of Mazel, owner of the shop where her father buy his material. He's handsome and teasing. Her father's friend, Felipe, would love to marry her, and…

films.title: Fortress
films.cast: Jesse Metcalfe, Bruce Willis, Chad Michael Murray, Kelly Greyson
films.description: The story revolves around a top-secret resort for retired U.S. intelligence officers. A group of criminals led by Balzary breach the compound, hellbent on revenge on Robert, forcing the retired officer and his son to save the day.

films.title: Two in the Wave
films.cast: Jean-Luc Godard, François Truffaut, Antoine de Baecque, Isild Le Besco
films.description: An in-depth analysis of the relationship between New Wave pioneers François Truffaut and Jean-Luc Godard, as seen through rare archival footage, interviews, and film excerpts — written and narrated by former Cahiers du Cinéma editor Antoine de Baecque.

films.title: School of Life
films.cast: François Cluzet, Jean Scandel, Eric Elmosnino, François Berléand
films.description: Paris 1930. Paul has only ever had one and the same horizon: the high walls of the orphanage, an austere building in the Parisian working class suburbs. Entrusted to a joyful country woman, Célestine, and her husband, Borel, the rather stiff gamekeeper of a vast estate in Sologne, the city child, recalcitrant and stubborn, arrives in a mysterious and disturbing world, that of a sovereign and wild…

films.title: Iron Island
films.cast: Ali Nasirian, Hossein Farzi-Zadeh, Neda Pakdaman
films.description: Squatters live on a mothballed oil tanker in the Persian Gulf. The children attend a school on board; men harvest scrap metal and old oil in the hull; women keep house and raise children and Captain Nemat runs it all with an iron hand. We follow a lad who rescues fish trapped in the hull, an old man who stares at the sun, the idealistic teacher, and Ahmad, the Captain's assistant who has fallen…

films.title: 5 Days of War
films.cast: Rupert Friend, Val Kilmer, Andy García, Dean Cain
films.description: An American journalist and his cameraman are caught in the combat zone during the first Russian airstrikes against Georgia. Rescuing Tatia, a young Georgian schoolteacher separated from her family during the attack, the two reporters agree to help reunite her with her family in exchange for serving as their interpreter. As the three attempt to escape to safety, they witness--and document--the…

films.title: Body Shots
films.cast: Jerry O'Connell, Amanda Peet, Sean Patrick Flanery, Tara Reid
films.description: The Los Angeles club scene is a place of booze-fueled decadence and debauchery. In a night full of possibilities, eight 20-somethings take to the clubs seeking good times, companionship and maybe a little sex. But in the harsh light of the morning after, their worlds are thrown into a spin of confusion when hungover Sara accuses hard-partying Mike of date rape. Loyalties are tested as each among…

films.title: 150 Milligrams
films.cast: Sidse Babett Knudsen, Benoît Magimel, Charlotte Laemmel, Isabelle De Hertogh
films.description: In the hospital where she works in Brest, France, a lung specialist discovers a direct link between suspicious deaths and state-approved medicine. She fights single-handedly for the truth to come out.

films.title: Elliot: The Littlest Reindeer
films.cast: Josh Hutcherson, Samantha Bee, Morena Baccarin, John Cleese
films.description: When Blitzen announces his retirement on December 21st, a miniature horse has 3 days to fulfill his lifelong dream of earning a spot on Santa's team at the North Pole try-outs.

films.title: Bad Roads
films.cast: Ihor Koltovskyi, Andrey Lelyukh, Anna Zhurakovskaya, Yuliya Matrosova
films.description: Four short stories are set along the roads of Donbass during the war. There are no safe spaces and no one can make sense of just what is going on.  Even as they are trapped in the chaos, some manage to wield authority over others. But in this world, where tomorrow may never come, not everyone is defenseless and miserable. Even the most innocent victims may have their turn at taking charge.

films.title: Family Members
films.cast: Tomás Wicz, Laila Maltz, Alejandro Russek, Edgardo Castro
films.description: Body-obsessed teenager Lucas and his mystically-inclined older sister, Gilda, unexpectedly become stranded when they travel to a nearly deserted coastal town to try to fulfill their dead mother's last wishes in whatever way they can.

films.title: Myanmar Diaries
films.description: How does it feel to be forgotten by the world? A powerful collective cry denouncing the crimes of the military dictatorship installed in Myanmar after the coup perpetrated on February 1, 2021: cinema and imagination against horror and in defense of freedom.

films.title: Gaspard at the Wedding
films.cast: Félix Moati, Laetitia Dosch, Christa Théret, Johan Heldenbergh
